notes.title: RAID: World War II - Update 21
notes.content:
Hello, Raiders!

We are as ready as we can be to finally push this update to release! 
Change-log can be found on the announcement from the beta build.
However, there is still a main issue we cannot resolve ourselves that will affect many people, which ultimately is entirely a waiting game: Nvidia drivers; TDR crashes.

What is a TDR crash and why is it important to list?
TDR stands for the Windows "Timeout detection and recovery" feature. Basically, whenever Windows thinks that the graphics card has hung up it will attempt to reset the entire driver causing the game to crash. With the DirectX 11 update of the engine some NVIDIA graphics card drivers seem to trigger this detection on RAID specifically, especially with more computationally intense tasks (like displaying lots of effects). 

As this is a feature of Windows and the graphics card driver this behavior is sadly out of our control. To fix this issue the graphics card driver would need to get an update preventing this crash, but that will likely still take some time to happen.

The game engine will try to recover from this scenario, but a hard driver reset cannot always be securely resolved, thus resulting in the game closing.

TDR crashes are found in the crash.txt log: "d3d11 (???) CreateDirect3D11SurfaceFromDXGISurface".
Note: This seems to be an isolated issue with Nvidia drivers only - AMD has no issues so far. If you do manage to reproduce this crash on system with an AMD graphics card please reach out to us!

(Edit) Please uninstall LUA mods!
Lua mods are not supported for updates this large, if your game is not launching and you have mods installed please be sure to remove the IPHLPAPI.dll or WSOCK32.dll files by hand, as verifying game cache will not remove these files.

Changelog from u21 Beta
This build is a similar build as the u21 beta build, there has not been many additional changes.

Vehicles now sync horn honking.
Flamer gas tanks should now count as flamer kills.
Distraction coins should now be far more reliable.
Implemented some animation blending to first person.
Added unlimited ammo pile to the camp.
Minor changes to challenge card interface.
Removed some incorrect voicelines on Countdown.
Changed total required gold for the maximum gold pile.
Added interactions for bag placing with flak/tank shells.
Changes to enemy spawn rates on all difficulties.
Vehicle nametags fade at a distance.
And more minor changes and bugfixes!


The "M.U.G" team
We have brought on another community member to help with development of Raid, Xeletron.
Ever since we brought him on things have been picking up in pace for the next update. We have a lot to show off for the in-development update 22!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30493300/95266b3d41e66afa844e8cf867f6521bfa6ffc11.png
This is a preface is to show a guideline of where some developmental ideas have taken the MUG crew; we cannot guarantee any of the following information will make it into update 22, some things might get cut, delayed or changed heavily.

Skills Rework
Out with the linear stat upgrades and mediocre abilities and in with the new pick-10 talent system!
We have done a lot of planning and have settled on a customization friendly skill system. Going forward were giving players more freedom to build their play-style in a meaningful way, with a progression format that lets us continue developing new skills based on feedback.
Here's an early version to give you an example on what it might be like;
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30493300/4a9f8dbb132c46275b861790d60a7ab76e775c18.png

Additional War-cries
You should be very familiar with this already, each class has their own war-cry. The new system allows us to give each class new war-cries to tinker with.

Boosters
Introducing boosts to help with cooperation and solo play, when playing with a team your boost will affect your team and each duplicate the team uses the effects increase in a balanced way to not waste potential with everyone choosing the same boost and to not be overpowered when stacked.

As an added effect if you are playing purely alone the boosts give an "Isolation Bonus" which is an effect that should greatly help when playing alone.

Talents
The meat of your build, these are the skills you apply that will define your play-style.

New Carry System
If you have played Raid for more than a few hours you should be very familiar with the unwieldy carry system it adopted from PAYDAY 2, We have made adjustments and now the bags you carry is not limited to one bag, or by a strict total amount, instead Raid now uses a weight system to determine your movement speed and carry capacity.
Here's an early version;
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30493300/f99f5f48bc389481e3337c1dfeff0e90863fbf72.png

Gold Crate, Gold Bar, Paintings
Here's an example when you grab carry items like these you will see the carry icon diamond fill up to indicate how burdened you are. Gold crates are very heavy, very often you will only be able to hold one, but with talent investments and boosts you could be carrying two or even three gold crates. Gold bars and paintings are considered light, you will be carrying around two to four of them in most cases.

Regardless of what you take if you become overburdened (fill bar turns red) your movement speed is heavily impacted.

Corpses and Un-stackable items
We have decided to keep some carry items as un-stackable items, dead bodies and artillery shells will remain limited.

Bonus loot
Many maps that aren't outlaw raids have bonus loot, these did not give gold rewards and only affected your end raid loot rewards, we're changing this to reward "Greed" which used to be rewarded through the loose valuables you take during most raids.

Interactivity Overhaul
We have started work on refining the games interaction and mini-game systems and have extended the system to other items.

Interaction Animations
More interactions are being given animations to give visual interest.

Lock-picking
This has largely stayed the same as before.

Rewiring
Some maps have lock-picking mini-games used for rewire interactions, we are working on a new mini-game that will be similar to lock picking but thematically appropriate.

Fuse Cutting
Any raid with a dynamite bag will be subject to this mechanic, when you begin deploying the dynamite bag you will have a skill mini-game that will shorten the fuse timer, failing a single segment of the mini-game will start the timer at whatever timer it showed on screen.
Here's an early version;
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30493300/72ef7d1cab1c52769d130945217e8033f1d7a3a6.png

Reviving
When a player is down and you begin reviving them a skill mini-game will show and with each successful hit the health they revive with is increased.

RAIDS
We're always working on something either cleaning up older maps or working on new ideas, here is some of what we got up to.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30493300/4330131ed22c468dbd659ab4d7c7e488ee1d9d39.png

GOLD RUSH
The return of gold piles, there was a issue long ago that forced Lion Game Lion to temporarily disable the spawning of the giant gold piles in the vaults, this will return and you will be able to steal as much as you wish.

TRAIN WRECK
More gold!! The raid on the gold train always seemed a little off, with dialogue even saying you can go back and get more gold. So we're adding more gold to the train to steal as optional loot.

SEA FORTS
What's this doing here..?

OPERATIONS
Slow progress but we're updating the operation missions in the city to look more lived in, right now the streets are very empty and not very messy which is strange given there's that whole war thing going on. We hope to fill that out more and make it more interesting in the future.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30493300/0f0087aa93ac0f4688bda3d3c2ee4c903e59eb37.png

Make sure to join our DISCORD to take a peak at news early, ask questions or find fellow raiders to play.

Until next time... #blammosweep

notes.title: RAID: World War II - Update 21 [Open Beta]
notes.content:
Hello, Raiders!

We are finally ready to announce the release of update 21 in open beta state and we need your help to make sure it's working stable before adding it to the main build. 

All instructions and information about how to participate in beta can be found in our discord server: here!
But the code to get into this specific beta is: TotalControlBlammoSweepU21
Please report any bugs or issues to the #public-feedback channel from inside the official discord.

We want to give a shout out to all the players who stuck with us as we continue to bring content into the game. It has been almost five years since the launch of RAID, and despite the lack of content from Update 19, we sincerely do thank the community for lifting the moral.

This update was made possible by our small team: Ilija, Leon, Rex, Matt, and the Community Moderators.
We also give thanks to our publisher, Starbreeze, for allowing continued support with RAID: World War II.

These updates, ever since Update 20, have been a passion project to make the game into a better state. And from what Update 21 has to offer, we can confidently say this is a huge step in the right direction. 

But please remember that with a small team of people, updates will not be as rapid as lets say a live service game or one that has an incentive to update. 

That being said, we appreciate your continued patience for any update after this one and we hope Update 21 makes RAID closer to the game it should have been since before its launch.

Recap
A while ago, we made the announcement that the game was re-rated, and so RAID: World War II was finally uncensored in Germany, ending years of our dear counterfeit Adolf.

But apart from that, we also teased that Update 21 was indeed happening, and after months of non-stop work here you have it. There is still so much more work to do but to avoid holding back these important changes any longer it was decided to save many of those for future updates.

The excitement over Update 20 was great to see! Modders are already hard at work to take advantage of the new modding capabilities, and players have been giving us all kinds of feedback for more content.

Thanks to the community, we now have a new batch of content, tweaks and fixes cooked up!

Heads up!
Due to the large amount of changes made many aspects of your progression will be not applied, 
You should not lose anything earned but weapon upgrades and skills will need to be reapplied.

DirectX 11
One of the biggest changes, for sure, will be the upgrade from DirectX 9 to DirectX 11! 
You'll definitely see a gigantic boost in performance and decrease to memory usage!
Note: There might be subtle shader differences and other minor issues due to the complexity of the changes made to the rendering. 
You must have a GPU that supports DirectX 11.1 to participate in the beta.

Gold Diggers: Outlaw Raid
Robbing art galleries and hijacking convoys surely must have been getting old for gold hunting raiders like yourself so we’ve found you an underground railway network that is being used to transport valuables across Berlin. Meet them halfway at an exposed section of track and take what is soon to be yours.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30493300/33e1dfa9007c5b9f39db412e80e2ea254f453b17.png
Spring Mine
Set and forget, just don't forget where you put them on the way back. These mines will leap from the ground and make whoever tripped it very unhappy.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30493300/d06ae92662b67d59f45e2f6e91226f644b0f353e.png
Achievements
Added some new achievements to give you something to do in the meantime.
Some changes have been made to existing achievements, see full change log.

 Minefield - Kill 644 enemies with mines.
 Watch Your Step - Kill at least 5 enemies with one mine.
 Librarian - Open the missions menu while owning every Outlaw Raid.
 Almost Like Royalty - Have in your possession 1000 bars of gold in the camp.


UPDATE 21 PATCHNOTES
U21 carries many fixes to issues, tweaking game balance, and adding new content!

New Content
- Added the “S-Mine” as a new throw-able mine.

 Unlocks at level 12 for the Recon class.
 Unlocks at level 20 for the Assault class.
 Unlocks at level 20 for the Insurgent class.
 Unlocks at level 10 for the Demolition class.

- The “Gold Leather Jacket” is now available in the PC release for 250 gold.
- Camp upgrade option for flags have been added.

 Default is a Desecrated enemy flag.
 Upgrade to Raid Gang flag for 150 gold.


Overhauls
- All raids and operations have been tweaked to have lower XP multipliers while still rewarding enough for fast progression.
- Recon’s War Cry head lock has been moved from level 40 to level 1.
- Recon’s level 40 skill has a new War Cry upgrade: Ricochet. 

 Head shots will make the bullet ricochet to nearby heads. 
 This ability works best on stationary targets.

- Recon’s War Cry now heals for all weapons with a reduced rate based on class.
- Assault's War Cry has been changed from instant healing to a slow heal over time.
- The Tutorial can now be skipped for newer players to the game.
- Weapons now have suppression stats.

 LMG weapons have the greatest suppression.
 Secondary weapons have the least suppression.

- Changed achievements that required 4 players to only require 2 or more.
- Character nationality and name can be changed.
- Decoy Coin Overhauls

 Raiders will now say an alternate line when throwing coins.
 Throw-able equipment pickups now grant 3 coins per visible grenade.

- All Outlaw Raids can now be collected and stored at the same time, once you collect all of them interactions are disabled on folders and Outlaw Raids are still limited to one use each.
- Outlaw Raids are now only consumed when escaping or failing the raid. Restarting and quitting will not consume the raid.
- All cosmetics are now buy-able with gold, prices depend on their rarity.
- Daily login bonus now gives more gold, and the day 5 reward has been replaced by Outlaw Raid intel (if you already have all Outlaw Raids, you'll receive 10 gold instead).
- Valuable small items reward more gold.
- Treasure chests reward much more total gold.

 Properly applied voice lines for valuable items taken

- Increased the XP gain from all Challenge Cards.
- Enemy AI should be less aggressive in co-op on higher difficulties.
- Fixed AI corpse detection in stealth.
- Weapons menu was reworked.

 Weapons now show their icons in the selection menu.
 Weapon parts can now be individually toggled by selecting the upgrade icon.

- Added seasonal tag to Halloween cards.

 Added Other tag to Challenge and Booster cards menu.

- Large health kits will now also restore one down in addition to its full healing.
- Locked supply crates are now brown to distinguish between the unlocked variation.
- Timers to unlock new raids is decreased slightly.
- The Camp has been cleaned up behind the scenes and now loads a few less extra things.
- Removed camp trophy case, Trophies may return in future.
- Grenades should swap to the most battle ready weapon (Has ammo in magazine, Primary, Secondary, Knife) when all are thrown.
- Fixed some view stances for many weapons when using high FOV settings.
- Added difficulty based gold reward multiplier for Outlaw Raids.

 Easy: 1x
 Normal: 1.2x
 Hard: 1.5x
 Very Hard: 2x

- Resetting a character's proficiency no longer uses a gold increase multiplier.
- Heavier carry items that originally would not let you sprint now have a sprint consumption penalty.
- All carry items have been made slightly heavier to account for your newfound ability to use legs at an increased pace.
- Throwing distances have been reduced slightly on some lighter bags.

Gameplay
- Corpses do not allow sprinting, but you can throw them slightly further.
- Added a motion dot, with multiple visual options.
- Added a toggle for tinnitus effects in sound options.
- Added third option for hit indicators to track the position of the hit.
- Added iconography weapon HUD elements, this can be toggled off in the settings.
- Added “Back out” button for the host of the lobby when entering a game to go back to the camp.
- War-cries no longer show in the call-outs wheel.
- Enemy health, grenade and ammo drops now have beams for better visibility.
- Spotters mortars do more damage to players and less damage to enemies.
- Flak guns are now more effective at shooting down planes than a handgun.
- Turn speeds increased greatly for both players and NPCs.
- Player mounted MGs now have a wider turn angle.
- Added a key-bind for toggling the HUD, Defaults to the H key.
- Fixed enemy debris parts not being properly spawned or removed.

Weapons
- The golden M1 rifle has been removed and now is a variation for the normal M1 that can be selected when the M1 is equipped.

 For transparency this is not confirming new skins or skin micro-transactions, but as this is a feature that can apply to all weapons we’re capable of releasing new cosmetic unlocks in the future for people who want more things to work towards.

- Sterling SMG now has a more usable base recoil and correct head shot multiplier.
- M1912 and Ithaca shotguns rate of fire increased to allow shooting when the pump animation is complete.
- M1912 and Ithaca shotguns recoil increased slightly to compensate for higher fire rates.
- M1 Carbine recoil increased slightly to compensate for a higher fire rate of 750.
- Mostly fixed Welrod's broken reload animation with reload speed skills.
- Tweaked damage falloff on the Pocket Double-Barrel Shotgun.
- Mounted M2 Machine Gun tweaks.

 Now overheats from 3.5s of fire from 10s.
 Dismember chance increased to 75% from 60%.
 Rate of fire increased and damage decreased slightly.

- Tweaked STG-44 scope to be easier to use.
- Fixed throw-ables and mortars not de-spawning in level transitions.

Missions
- Countdown

 Fixed the airlock not consistently detecting all players being inside.

- Kelly

 Fixed miscellaneous art and navigation issues.

- Wiretap

 Changed Cutting Crew Achievement to work with 2 players.
 De-cheesed some of map and the way the tank operates.
 The bell is now ring ding ding-able.

- Last Orders

 Added another body dump location to make hiding bodies less of a walk.
 Fixed NPC rag dolls freaking / glitching out in some of the spawn areas.

- Rogues Gallery

 Fixed some minor issues.

- Tiger Trap

 Cleaned up some collisions.
 Sewer guards are now more spaced apart.
 Fixed an issue where the tanks could launch you into the air.
 Corrected the timer for dynamite fuses.
 Now rewards a bonus 20% base XP per extra tank destroyed.

- Bunker Busters

 Fixed Night Witches path finding getting completely stuck in the stairway.
 Escort raids now reward a bonus 25% base XP per escort saved.

- Amber Train

 Added a secret crate with an abundance of greed loot that only people who read the change logs will find; It's in the center areas so just shoot some floor level crates a bit and you’ll find them.

- Rhinegold

 In the finale, the required kill count has been lowered from 100,150,200,250 to 100,125,150,200 for each respective difficulty.

- Gold Rush

 In the escape section some barriers were removed, the walk to the plane is now much shorter in most cases.

- Extraction

 Now has vehicle escape objectives.
 Truck keys now use a proper model.

- Forest Convoy

 The gang will stop nagging you about finding a truck after you already found the truck.


Tweaks
- Overall size of the game has been reduced.
- Upgraded to DirectX 11 rendering, includes performance benefits.
- The “mod_overrides” folder has been moved from “assets\mod_overrides” to just “mods”

 Mods created for mod_overrides will have to be moved to the mods folder instead.
 If you still have a mod_overrides folder the game will display a warning in the menu instructing you on how to move the files over to the new system.
 Additionally the following file types have been added that can now be overridden: “object, cooked_physics, environment, scene, movie, shader, render_template_database, decals, camera_shakes, world_sounds”, which will allow modders to override more files and easier make changes to the existing assets of the game.

- Fixed many shader issues that were tanking performance.
- Crash logs will now show script stacks. This will allow us and modders to have more accurate crash logs to help with fixes for updates and mods.
- Launch option for debugging localization: -loc_help
- Asset loading of the engine has been reworked to be significantly faster.
- Compressed game assets, reducing the size of the game and future updates.
- Cleaned up unnecessarily frequent network calls between clients.
- Fixed Flamers backpack and armor vanishing when multiple spawn.
- Fixed outlaw raid HUD icon errors.
- Fixed many assets accidentally using censored textures in the normal release.
- Fixed mission UI not updating stamps when swapping to Operations.
- Fixed a bug where players could damage vehicles with friendly explosions.
- Fixed some contour issues on the camp tables and upgrades.
- Environment changes applied to some levels.
- Fixed enemies dropped weapons blocking interactions.
- Fixed some inaccuracies with the German translation.
- Fixed issue where mud craters could push the player out the map.
- Fixed bug where you could not properly swap weapons when carrying bags.
- Fixed many stuck spots in many maps of the game.
- Flamers flammable tanks are better indicated.
- Flamers have increased resistance to make the gas tank a higher priority.
- Dog tags now have a flare effect to make them harder to miss.
- Dog tag spawn less with the same total rewards being the total.
- Dog tag spawn locations have been updated on many levels.
- Scopes are now toggled parts unlocked at their lowest Decrease Spread tier.
- Explosive red barrels now produce pools of fire when exploding.
- Explosive wine barrels are now a visible red color to better indicate their explosive properties.
- Improved the texture quality on many assets.
- Skill tree UI now allows mouse scrolling to shift left and right.
- Grenades should now be slightly more reliable on sloped terrain.
- Playtime timer should now reset on level transitions.
- Reworked 3D menu scenes lighting and alignments.

That sure was a lot wasn't it?

P.S. We suggest you to backup your savefile if you decide to participate in the beta to avoid losing progress.

notes.title: RAID: World War II - Newsletter 12/12/2022
notes.content:
Hello, fellow Raiders!

Work is still going strong on the next update with a documented changelog over 100 lines long! Please note the team for update 21 is very small so it will take more time to finalise the update, Patience is key.
The upcoming update will be a beta branch to get proper testing in and on the full release of update 21 the version before it will be preserved as its own beta branch if you ever want to go back.
In the mean time we have prepared a list of major changes coming:


New Outlaw Raid
An off the books raid where you block a train passing through an exposed section of underground rail, the train of course is carrying all kinds of valuables.
Progress on the level is very close to completion, more gameplay testing is needed and feedback from the beta will go towards updates to the new outlaw raid.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30493300/ecd7bcbee4558834a8c6b3fcbdfc3aeff4930516.jpg


New Throwable Type
New shipment arrived and it includes a new throwable weapon, It will be very handy for keeping the enemy off those valves.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30493300/149e3fbbde20a783d23840e768f641d46949f73f.jpg

Engine Changes

A great deal of effort has gone into pushing Diesel engine out of the early 2000s (by a year or two) with changes to rendering, this should include a big performance increase for most GPUs.
With these engine changes includes new bundle compression.
Improvements to load times.
Less restrictive mod_overrides will be included, some file types were not included such as unit files for example.
Unfortunately most lua based mods will not work and may need updating.


Major Bugfixes

The issues with detection and impossible alerts in stealth have been fixed.
Flamers armor now spawns correctly so theyre now a real challenge again.
Crashlog script stacks are now set up to make reporting crashes easier.
And many more...


Tweaks

Enemy balance is the biggest struggle to manage in Raid due to varying player counts, class preferences and the many issues that need to be resolved with the Ai of the game, there are changes but do not expect them to be permanant as we plan on going through and cleaning up as best as we can in future updates.
Some weapons have been balanced to be more enjoyable to use, Specifically weapons like the Sterling SMG.
Pickups were changed so now grenades are no longer wasted and will instead decrement.
Automatic pickup on smaller ammo/health drops will be enabled, This mechanic has been a fair point of critisism but we dont want to give up on it entirely.
Large medical cases return a single down for the user.
Recons warcry is less strict with your controls, health regen applies to all weapons with scaling and now includes a ricochet effect exclusive to sniper rifles to handle crowds of enemies better.
Outlaw Raids are no longer limited to one, you can collect every outlaw raid and pick which you want to play when you want to play them.
Cosmetic items are no longer purely loot drops, they can be bought for gold.
Raids with excess objectives now reward bonus XP, for example saving both Nightwitches grants +25% bonus XP per escort, with this XP values have been lowered slightly on those maps but overall you will gain more XP for doing more than the minimum required objectives.
And most importantly we put the greatest amount of effort into making the bell in Wiretap dingable.



If there's any suggestions, feedback or bugs you know of please do make a post on the discussions, every bit helps improve the quality of the future updates!


Join LION GAME LION discord in order to be first to see an update and find fellow raiders to play and discuss the game!

notes.title: Update 20
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30493300/163ea61be8a3ba9061aa89aab3ffcdf4c7a90230.jpg

This update to RAID: World War 2 includes the following changes and fixes:

PATCH NOTES

Fixed an issue causing the game to crash on startup related to new intel CPUs
Fixed an issue related to the error message “ctrInitializeCriticalSectionEx” preventing the game from starting (This means that there should be less redist- related issues)
Added “DB:create_entry” making it easier for modders to add things into the game ( This means that modders can now add their own files to the game! )
Fixed the profile error where game would crash when you have too many profiles
Raised the “Bonus XP Loot drop” by 10x
Raised mission failed XP from 0.05, to 0.1
Raised XP multiplier from difficulty on completing missions:
Easy :    x2   (was x1 )
Normal: x3  ( was x2 )
Hard    : x8  ( was x5 )
V hard : x15 ( was x10 )
Increased health on teammates to 400 ( was 200 )

What the *!*!, a RAID update, ?!

Yes, we noticed that a lot of new people who buy the game get a very specific crash, and felt the need to fix it so that the game runs, this only affected people with newer CPUs. This should hopefully be working good now (Our testing shows its fine) And since we got a greenlight from our publisher, we also wanted to add the long awaited modding feature, so that modders can add their own files to the game. And while we did all that, there were some things (mostly the XP ) that we wanted to change while we were at it.

Why now? Why not earlier?!

This is a question that would take way to long to answer. But in short, we have been working on other things in order for our company to survive, and had to put raid on the side, because 1: It takes a lot of developers to do even small things in the diesel engine, and 2: we need to live, and this game is not making us any money, so we needed to put our resources elsewhere. We are also working on something new that hopefully we will be able to show some time soon(TM).

Another BIG reason for this is our community, and without our team of COMMUNITY MODS, Draza, Matt, Dysphorid and Sylvanas Windrunner, this would not have been possible, thanks for all the help guys! Also, A very big thank you goes out to LeonTheo02, he is the reason this patch even got made, without his help this would not have been possible, so thank you Leon, for the long nights, the screen shares, and all the digging through the old project, server and code to make this possible. Another thanks goes out to the streamer b33croft, who acted as a tester for the new cpu crash fix, and streamed the game last weekend!

Will there be more?!

As of now, we do not know, we are definitely open for more. But we will be watching and following people playing, and if we see/find things that break the game, we will do our best to fix it and add more fixes as we go, currently, it just is not something that we can promise.

We really do hope that you enjoy the changes, and hope to see some fun new mods, and if we are really lucky, the level editor in RAID.

Discord
Our discord has a bunch of helpful people, and most of the times you will be able to find people to play with on there as well. If you are a modder, there is a section for that as well on there, so do not be shy, and come join us:
 COME JOIN OUR DISCORD SERVER 


//Over and out, Ilija

notes.content:

Raiders! Time has come, Update 19 is here! We really hope that you enjoy the new additions, changes and fixes to the game. Remember to keep us posted on any feedback or issues that you find in the forums, or come join us on our discord for good chats with helpful people.

 Additions

    Added the "Kelly" raid into the game

Tweaks

notes.title: RAID: World War II - Update 19 : DAY 3 Reveal
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/b0bc03a75bd5f037580cf31e6e69b68441ffb700.png

Hey Raiders!

Welcome to announcement day 3!
You have seen the Decoy Coin to lure guards away and improve your stealth gameplay, the new Kelly level which is playable in both loud and stealth, and now... it is time for the addition many of you have requested!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/affa11b9f49ab20b9c59b66a8b63d41d8f7a9d05.png

 Introducing: Welrod!
Introducing the Welrod! This British bolt action, magazine fed suppression pistol was developed during World War II, and the epitome of suppression guns. It was used by the regular forces and the resistance against the Nazi regime, and now the RAID Gang have them!

Since we are looking at Stealth as a key gameplay element we want to improve in RAID, there is no better weapon to introduce then the Welrod.
Since we also made adjustments to the guards so that they don’t instantly go into an alert, using the Welrod will allow you to sneak up and take out patrols without being seen if timed correctly. Then all you have to do is clean up the bodies and dump them in places the enemy can’t see!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/9da0fba22be990d34bbaa58633f8e13b2d66525d.jpg

 Changes in stealth:
Some levels will now have respawning guards, and their ability to see and find dead bodies is better. So hiding dead Nazi corpses is more important than ever. Remember, Killing Nazis is fun! But you need to clean up after yourself.

The respawn guards system is something that we want to go over all levels and add. But this will happen through patches down the line after we get some more feedback from you guys.

https://i.imgur.com/DPkjMJ2.gif

 Yea yea yea... just give us the update and the patch notes...
Woah easy there, patch notes will be posted when the update goes live.

We tried to get it out today, however you will have to wait until tomorrow ( Friday ) for the update since we and the testers need some more time for the final checks. Until then, stay safe, kill Nazis, and Blammo!

See you all tomorrow!




 Once again we would like to thank community (and master modder/memer) member "Matthelzor" for the artwork!

notes.title: RAID: World War II - Update 19 : DAY 2 Reveal
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/b0bc03a75bd5f037580cf31e6e69b68441ffb700.png

Raiders!

Day 2 has come, hopefully you are looking forward to the new Decoy coin! Now if only there were more stealth levels in RAID to use the coin in you say?

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/c168159160e3339e38544ac1e8317166b144d04b.jpg

 Introducing the new Raid "Kelly"!
"Kelly" is the newest raid added for the greediest of players.

Kelly can be completed fully in stealth, and there are a couple of new things that we haven't done before here. For example, the weather and time of day are randomized. The level can be played during the day, night, and in heavy fog/rain. This is a new thing that we want to try. We hope to hear your thoughts on wanting to see this more in the future.

https://i.imgur.com/oMoIu5E.gif

 Story
Mrs. White and the RAID gang got wind of the Nazis taking a large amount of stolen gold from France into Germany. They are tasked with intercepting and stealing the gold from a temporary Nazi bank. Make sure you steal the gold before it's transported out of Berlin!


 But, I like to blow shit up..
Do not worry! If the alarm goes off, ( or you simply wish to go loud from the start ) The vault will lock, and the gang will as always use some drastic measure to get into it. A tank is called in and, after you clean the path to the bank for it, the gang uses it together with some cable to simply pull the doors off the hinges.



https://i.imgur.com/BzE6bqg.gif


 Day 3
Check in with us again tomorrow for the day 3 announcement, we got one more thing to show you, and we think you are going to like it!

Also, full patch notes and change log tomorrow!

notes.title: RAID: World War II - Update 19 : DAY 1 Reveal
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/b0bc03a75bd5f037580cf31e6e69b68441ffb700.png

Hey Raiders!

This update will come in three phases, we will announce something for every day up until the launch ( We are planning to launch Thursday 17:th )

The update is focused on some new stealth mechanics and some minor changes to how stealth works.

Full patch notes with bug fixes and tweaks etc will be posted on the last day before the update goes live. We also want to give a huge thanks to the community members who helped out with the testing, as well as the competition winners that got to try an early beta version, and gave us some feedback.

Now:

 Update 19 Day 1: 
Welcome to the day 1 reveal of Update 19!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/c2f5f9affc17420ea4e564f32f257f2999049d71.png

 Introducing the "Decoy coin" 
The Decoy coin can be equipped in the grenade slot, and the player will start with 15 of them in the inventory. They can be replenished by picking up the grenade pickups from dead enemies, or crates around the levels.

The coin is used to distract enemies, and if used correctly ( Thrown in a place that a guard can reach ) an enemy will hear the coin hit the ground and walk over to the location to inspect. This gives you the time to sneak around them.

The coin can also be used to lure enemies into less visible areas for easier kill targets, where another enemy has less chance to see the dead body.

https://i.imgur.com/Do5VWHh.gif

https://i.imgur.com/Neb9p87.gif

How will you use it? what crazy tactics will you come up with using these? Make sure to tell us on the forums when you do something cool!

 Big thanks to community member "Matthelzor" for providing art for the update

notes.content:

Hey Raiders!

Welcome to this week’s update!

On our newsletter this week we let you know what the bug fixes were, but we wanted to add a little surprise also.

For this week you also get the Browning Auto 5!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/d47125e4123ed336ff3c27e9fa13aec038c1964b.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/81c561040d39363d10cb875fb53c79eb65fbb719.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/0ca37c7231bebf764138cf7c70b8e138922340cc.jpg


Designed as a rapid-fire weapon, it adds extra “blammo” fire power to the Demolition and Insurgent classes. To compensate for the rapid fire, the weapon holds 5 shells but with a starting total held ammo count of 20.

Of course, through using the Proficiencies and Weapon Upgrades you will be able to increase and find the combination that works for you!

The Browning Auto 5 unlocks for the following classes:

•    Demolition at Level 33
•    Insurgent at Level 40

Other bug fixes:

•    Added Controller key binds for weapon skills, and toggling weapon cosmetics
•    Fixed a bug where enemies health was inflating every time a level was loaded
•    Fixed team AI being stun locked
•    Changed all clothing customization to be also purchasable with gold (except items that came as special content)
•    Changed multiplier for proficiency respec cost so it’s cheaper and cost scales lower

As always, we love your feedback so continue to talk to us!

Raiders!

Hope you all had a fantastic Easter and some quality time with your families!
We wanted to give you a little update on what is happening in the production for RAID, and give a status update on first of all the "Kelly RAID" but also some things that we are working on for future updates.

 KELLY RAID 

This is what is taking most of our time, we are mostly finishing up the visible bugs and ironing out some pacing issues that we have had with the level. The main thing with the pacing is to get a nice balance between the stealth and loud versions of the level feel good.
What is taking the most time now is the VO, and we are recording that at the end of this week. We are also using the opportunity to record VO for a couple of other things while we have all the actors in one place, these are:

 Filling holes on previous content where we felt there is VO missing.
 Adding some lines to the stealth game play and making that more  immersive.
Recording lines for a future update that we will talk about, very soon.




https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/7fe4c3ee0368b9136483e2c0aad0195b5dffe427.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/598d122e1380e9e85cc9359778b639cdaa0597e4.jpg

And off course the content that will come with the updates ( that we are not yet ready to reveal ) is something that we are hard at work on.


 FUTURE CONTENT 
The next thing we want to mention that we are working on besides "Kelly" is a daily mission system. Which will give you some extra cool new game play additions to all the current levels, and another way to get some more of that juicy gold.

More details on this will come in future newsletters however. Now stop eating Easter eggs and other delicious foods, and get back to killing some Nazis!

notes.title: RAID: World War II - Weekly Newsletter 19/03/2018
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/b0bc03a75bd5f037580cf31e6e69b68441ffb700.png

Hey Raiders!

We noticed some discussions about the community wanting some information, and as we mentioned we will show more on the next Stream. But! Just to ease your minds and let you know what’s going on for the next update here is a status update:

Kelly Level
The new Kelly level is coming along nicely, and as we mentioned we are heads down trying to get it ready for launch at the moment. A few things we are working on:

Voice Overs
For Kelly we have finalised the script and working on the technical set up, and after that it will be added to the game by level design. We are also looking at actors booking slots to get all the lines recorded!

Mission Pacing
We have all the elements and objectives in the Kelly level, and are working to randomise them, and also to pace them out so that it all triggers and tells the level story well.

Bugs
We have been looking at some of the annoying bugs that you are experiencing and we aim to have fixed (amongst other bugs):

Enemy Health Stacking
You guys experienced the enemy health stacking through as the player was restarting the game, which made hard and very hard especially difficult on multiple restarts. We aim to have this fixed!

Team AI Knockback
Team AI would regularly go into a knock back animations when taking damage, which would stop their effectiveness in gun fights, which is another one on our fix list.

Controller Support
Some menus such as the Weapon Selection Screen didn’t have full controller support and this will be another one we look to have fixed.

Note:
We are working on some other juicy things, but aren’t ready to announce them yet!

Hey Raiders!

Hey Raiders!
Thanks for everyone who joined the Free Weekend and we hope you had a great time, and decided to stick around and be part of our community! The offers are still on and will be until the 19th for anyone who wants some time to think about it. Certainly, we loved seeing the player base increase and we hope you all found coop missions to join!

We had a stream on Friday to talk about some developments, and we wanted to share some of these with you all!

This weeks patch
We are now working on the patch for this wednesday, and some of the things that we couldnt finish in time for the friday patch will be fixed there along with some other issues brought up by the community.

Ending on the new Countdown raid, and grenade stats are some of the things that will be in on Wednesday.

XP and Gold Rewards
We are looking into further tweaks on this system to refine it, and we hope to have more updates ready in a patch soon. One thing we want to accomplish is a decent rate of rewards across all levels, in particular with Gold, but we just wanted to hint on that, and you’ll find out more on the reasons for the Gold rewards soon!

Level Code Named: Kelly
We haven’t shown any gameplay of this level yet, but its coming along nicely, and we will soon be going into a closed beta! We did announce the competition winner from our shotgun competition to be invited for the Kelly level Beta and we will have a Stream in the not so distant future for that!

Stealth
We mentioned in our Friday stream that we are now looking into Stealth, and as part of that we are looking into the potential stealth arsenals that the player could have. If you have a favourite, we would love to hear about it! For all you guys that didn’t know, the in-development level codenamed: Kelly will have stealth as an intricate part of its level design!

notes.title: RAID: World War II - Update 15! New map, new content, new price!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/9cb1842f1511f002f89673e8eaeb6544ca7e53c8.jpg
Hey Raiders!
 Webpage Version

Welcome to the hot new RAID: World War II update! We have some juicy new content wrapped up into this update so without further ado, the latest news!

Content Launch Celebration!

Price Drop

Today RAID: World War II gets a permanent price drop on the Base Game and Special Edition! It will be set to 19.99. If the previous price was a little too high then we hope you like the new one!

Sale

As part of the price drop, we will be celebrating with a 50% discount! For all all those interested in RAID: World War II now is a great time to get it and play the latest free expansion pack!

Free weekend

We will be starting a RAID: World War II will be on a free weekend from today! If you're on the border of trying it out, now is the perfect time!

Website Update:

Please check out our new website update we made especially for the release of Countdown and the latest content expansion:


 CHECK IT OUT HERE!

All New Content Update!

New Level
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/16744c521b669793f08315f8de39fc12cd24c03b.jpg
During development we codenamed this new level “Silo”, but it now has an official name: “Countdown”.

The Raid Gang are in an all-out action-packed mission to infiltrate and cause maximum destruction on an early prototype missile bunker which holds a V2 rocket!

New Primary Weapon
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/5617d38b61597fe4cc6c4a8ecc7827a3cd1b9388.jpg
There were many requests for the Lee Enfield weapon and we thought it was time to put this amazing bolt action magazine fed rifle into RAID: World War II for you all to enjoy!

The Lee Enfield is unlocked at level 33 for the Recon class.
 
New Secondary Weapon
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/b773536fa2b2dd8b47a27095c98e8d42f7be9fa1.jpg
You now have even more ways to blast Nazis with this handy sawn-off shotgun! Perfect for those close quarter take outs, why not try it in the Countdown mission!

The Sawn-off Shotgun is unlocked at level 8 for Demolition Class and at level 11 for all other classes.
 
New Grenade
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/6e1077328dc5cd1f811de0ee6af5b87dc8bccdd9.jpg
As we showcased, the Mills Grenade (or Mills bomb as some would call it) is a classic, and an early fragmentation grenade used by the British Army during world war I. The mills is a short ranged large damage grenade.

The Mills Grenade Unlocks at level 31 for all classes.
 
New outfit
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/397a83224e80c42a66579864609c99dee4bdd434.jpg
We love this Bomber jacket and pants set, and we hope to see lots of Raiders wearing the latest in military fashion during these cold days. The jackets are made with the very best leather and lined with sheepskin!
 
XP and Balancing

We have spent some time closed beta testing changes for the grind complaints. Remember that we continue to make changes after this, so your feedback is welcome!

This update contains the following changes:

XP requirements per character have been lowered
Weapon challenges have been adjusted and you should see the overall stats lower
The distance-based challenges have lowered distances cross all tiers
The tier 4 specials-based challenges are now drastically lowered
Some stats have increased to align with the weapon archetype and tier
Operations now give much more XP at increasing values

Previous Competition Winners

We have added the propaganda competition winners names into the camp, and also their poster designs are now throughout the game!

Additional Fixes

Programming

Added functionality that ensures that the clients are granted their mission  rewards if the host leaves before they have time to receive them
Fixed incorrect total health calculation in skill tree screen



Level

Changed interaction positions on all dog tags. Dog tags should now all be obtainable


Design

Slightly lowered the amount of team health regen on Assault. At max level it should now do 40% team health regen instead of 50%

Stream

Tune in tomorrow when we do a live Stream and talk about this update and more! Join us at 7pm CET!

Current Competition

Tomorrow we will be announcing the winners of the shotgun competition!

Countdown Raid

The countdown raid comes with something that is completely new to us, it is built out of multiple levels, and certain parts will change completely from play through to play through. Not only the layout, but also the objective in those parts will vary.

We really hope you enjoy this new map tomorrow! and that you look forward to new ones as much as we do!

notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/3337d1eaa3756588c376f4e94b3b2bf340a44641.png
Hey Raiders!

Welcome to the first ever community competition run by the CM team! We're super excited to start these and will do more in the future! We hope you participate in these contests and give a chance for these new types of competitions.
And today's competition is....  Browning A5 Vs Ithaca.


Sterling and Wolfgang took a short break to recover from the recent Nazi killing mission (more news on that soon).

Meanwhile, Rivet and Kurgan were at the Raid base camp and some resistance members showed up with 2 brand-new wooden crates. They rushed over but the boxes were empty except a letter from Mrs white in them. The letter read:

“Dear Raid Gang,
These crates represent 2 new weapons we want to send you, but manufacturing is limited to just one of them. There is only one way to sort this out. Wild west style. Send me a postcard of you in your very best action pose with your favourite of the 2 weapons.
Yours sincerely,
Mrs White”

Rules:

   Pick one of the 2 raiders: Rivet for the Browning A5 or Kurgan for the Ithaca
  Take a picture, art or any image that looks like a postcard
  Pose your characters with the appropriate shotgun and give them a quote in the voice of that character
    Needs to use a quote for the gun in the image (quote must be in character, like something they would say)
  Send you postcards here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/414740/discussions/0/1699415798764031100/

Winner receives:

  Special Edition of RAID: World War II
  Name in the camp
    The chosen Shotgun developed into the game
    Invite into the beta of the Codenamed: Kelly level on the next available community stream
here are few example for you:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/397880c7675dca13ffeb59ba487be65f62ce9470.png

notes.title: RAID: World War II - Weekly Newsletter 29/01/2018
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/7dc4177b25ade99c0cd3ea0662db49cccaeb1658.jpg

Hey Raiders!

Thanks for being patient with us since our return back from Christmas holidays. We realize that we were a little quiet but, we are starting to get into the groove of things and some hot new updates are planned soon!

More details on that below but firstly, we have seen some gossip on the interwebs about LgL, its staffing and the future for RAID. We don’t want to get involved in gossip, and we think our energy is better spent on development, and we hope you all agree too. But to be completely transparent, neither LGL or RAID is dead.


New Level!
Announcing a new level! This one isn’t Silo, but an all new one! Code named: KELLY. It takes places with the raid gang going deep into Berlin to take out one of the Nazis main banks. This time, they intend to get very rich out of it! More news on that soon, but below you can see screenshots from an early development build.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/a63a60fab74b340bcef88994ef931825ad3b5642.jpg
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/e16095f65eef08ca6c5a43844c406579fa96d3ad.jpg
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/6737213ae5382979674b200801a4423385b77e0e.jpg


Community Fridays
It’s been a while since we did this, and you know we love it when you guys are creative. So… This week we will announce a new competition! We have weapons, which one will you choose to be in the game next! As usual it won’t be a straight up competition but a chance for you to be creative!

Silo Release
We are close, oh so close, to releasing Silo. Just got to fix some bugs and make sure its as good as it can be for release. For the ones still reading, you should get excited! It won’t be just Silo, but a juicy update is planned for you soon! We will do a larger announcement on that shortly, so keep your eyes peeled! We also wanted to post some screenshots of the progression of the Silo level:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/a2fe750726c9f897376a28660dae869a071a5e29.jpg
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/345adb6aa6e08b75f2f4417ff72a41679ae9aaed.jpg
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/2837af91be388a4975d748f509cdc71dccaf1b2a.jpg

XP and Grind
Thank you all so much for your feedback! We have made changes to lots of stats that effect the XP curve and progression in general. These changes are in a closed beta and we are testing them out, expect the update to be released very soon. As soon as we get closer to something “tangible” we will share the details with you guys, and then continue on from there.

Newsletters
We will now release newsletters every other week for RAID. We think that this is a better cadence of information being released as we have time to accumulate more juicy news that will be closer to being in the version released. So, in case its confusing, the next newsletter will be on 12th February.

Live Streams
It sure has been a while since you have seen our faces and have had live interactions with us, so we are updating you guys on the timings of the streams. So! Announcing that the Streams will be every other week, on the weeks that we don’t do newsletters. The next stream will be on 9th February.

Programming
- Fixed an issue with grenades, which did not do any melee damage

Art

- Fixed an issue on Rogues Gallery, where a sniper could not be shot when shooting from a certain angle.
- Fixed a LOD issue in the camp, with the level 2 version of the piano.
- Fixed an issue on Last Orders, where the sommelier would not show an outline for the drop in client.

Level Design
- Fixed an issue on Forest Convoy, where a sniper could be seen floating in the air.
- Fixed an issue on Urgent Delivery, where the player could not interact with a greed item.
- Fixed an issue on Rogues Gallery, where enemies stopped spawning when standing on certain locations on the map.

Text
- Fixed capitalization on the concrete grenade.
- Rephrased the Recon warcry description.

Animation
- Fixed an issue with the Sten recoil, when having certain upgrades applied.

notes.content:

Hey Raiders!

Welcome to the weekly patch!

Below you can find the details / changelist for the week:

Programming:
- Fixed an issue with weapon recoil not reseting properly.
- Fixed an issue with the spacing between sliders in the menus.

Level Design: 
- Fixed an issue on Last Orders, where the outline of the halftrack would not show for drop in clients
- Fixed an issue on Last Orders, where the players would be seen clipping when inside the foxholes.
- Fixed an issue on Forest, where players could get stuck between a tree and a crate.
- Fixed an issue on The Amber Train, where players would get pushed over a gate by the collision there.
- Fixed an issue on The Amber Train, where players would get pushed out of the level in the secret room.
- Removed a turret on Gold Rush, because placement was incorrect.
- Fixed an issue on Strongpoint, where enemies would be able to shoot through a wall.
- Fixed an issue on Strongpoint, where the escape truck was missing the driver.
- Fixed an issue on Flakturm, where a crowbar in a truck would not be visible.
- Fixed an issue on Extraction, where a crate could be seen clipping through a truck.
- Fixed an issue where players would be able to jump through one of the windows of the church.

Art: 
- Fixed a minor visual bug on Gold Rush, z-fight issue on escape gate.

notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/163ea61be8a3ba9061aa89aab3ffcdf4c7a90230.jpg

Hey Raiders!

Welcome to the weekly patch!

And what a patch we have for you this week! As we mentioned in the weekly update this patch adds some exciting content.
Before we go into the patch just to mention a few community based activity.

Propaganda Poster Competition

This evening we will announce the finalists of the Propaganda Poster competition, where you get to vote for the top 3 posters that will make it into RAID: World War II!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/81a9e21be444cfe1fad7bbaa0498f9d8815290ea.jpg

Friday Stream

On Friday at 7pm CET, we will have a live stream with the community mods where we will go over what non-official mods have been made by the community. On Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/liongamelion

Weekly Patch

Remember that we continuously look to improve your experience. If you don’t see an update relevant for you know, please keep an eye out and be active as we try to listen to the community as much as possible.

New content:

Karabiner 98k

The legendary bolt-action rifle used by the German Wermacht. Unlocked at level 10 for Recon characters.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/25f36571802a4fd4dd51cd6efb9b7e43e824248b.jpg

343D Grenade

The defensive version of the Danish-designed hand grenade. Unlocked at level 19 for Demolition characters, level 20 for Insurgent characters and level 21 for Recon and Assault characters.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/8134afc38a7b42cf65cb47d0d27ebc9806e2767a.jpg

Programming:

Recon Warcry Rework

Now the recon war cry has an added self-heal per kills dealt, while the warcry is active. This self-heal will upgrade per warcry level. The heal is only applied to Sniper type weapons.
We have changed the Warcry upgrades. Now at warcry level 2 it adds self-heal and at warcry level 3 the lock-on range widens. At warcry level 5 is when the recon class gets the head lock-on.

Art:

- Fixed a minor art issue on the crane at Trainyard.

Tech Art:

- Fixed the interaction on 2 paintings at Art Storage
- Fixed an issue on Extraction where players were able to interact with the suitcase through the wall.
Level Design:
- Fixed an issue on The Amber Train level where players were able to use collisions to jump over a gate.
- Fixed an issue on Bunker Busters, where players got stuck between the opening doors and the wall. Recreated a part of the room so players can't get stuck anymore.
- Fixed an issue when players would reach the bottom of the ladders on the Trainwreck level the game would crash, we had no opportunity to experience this crash as of for now, we had 2 random events that activate when you reach the bottom of the stairs, for now we disabled these, so the game should not crash anymore. We will look further into this issue to figure out which of the events crashes the game, so we can re-enable them at a later stage.

Hey Raiders!

Welcome to the weekly RAID: World War II newsletter!

This is an exciting week for us, since we wanted to surprise you all with a little content update! The content will be delivered in this week’s patch update!

Weapons
This week you will receive a new weapon! The Karabiner 98k will be added to the game! And here is a render we made to all those not sure what the weapon looks like:

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/25f36571802a4fd4dd51cd6efb9b7e43e824248b.jpg

Another addition to this week’s content push is the D34D Grenade! We had a grenade competition not long ago, and thought we want you to have more ways to make things go boom! And again, here is a render of what the weapon looks like:

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/8134afc38a7b42cf65cb47d0d27ebc9806e2767a.jpg

Polish / Balance
Inline with the additional Karabiner 98k (sniper type weapon) you have in store, we also will be putting some polish onto the recon class Warcry!

Now the Recon Warcry is re-balanced to perform better with sniper type weapons, it will have:

-	An increased hit-chance
-	Locks into the body when at hip-fire, but locks into the head when in iron-sight / scopes
-	A small health regen is given to the Recon character when making kills while the Warcry is active
Other weapons do not get this Warcry rebalance.

Community Moderators
This week by the end of the week we will decide on the applicants to the community moderators, so you have a final chance if you want to apply to be one then below is the link. Remember this is a LgL thing, not just for RAID.

APPLY HERE

Propaganda Posters Competition
To all those who are taking part in the Propaganda Posters competition, good job! We love them so far, and our concept artist can’t want to get his hands on the final ones.

If you haven’t submitted one yet, why not! Give it a try, even if you think you can’t draw, remember it’s the creative idea that counts. So make some artwork and place it here:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/414740/discussions/0/1488866813761598607/

Hey Raiders!

Welcome to Community Fridays!

The theme for this week is all about propaganda! The Axis and the Allies spent a lot of time on propaganda and some really interesting things came out of it. So, we thought what better way than to inspire you, the community to get creative around this.

RAID Propaganda Posters

So here are the rules:
-	Create as many propaganda posters as you like
-	If you have more than one post, post them individually, so that each poster is a unique entrance
-	The propaganda posters can be either from the point of view of the Allies or the Axis
-	We will curate the finalists
-	The community will vote on the winners!
-	Our concept artist will turn your artwork into the final piece of art
-	The artwork will go into the game!

Competition hours:
-	You can put your propaganda posts up today!
-	On Thursday 7th December next week, we will curate the finalists and start the community voting
-	On Monday 11th December we will announce the winners!

Winners get:
-	Their name etched into the camp
-	Their posters in the game!
-	Invited to a special stream!
-	A Special Edition copy of RAID: World War II
We have fun when the community are creative, and we hope you do too! So please all join!

notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/163ea61be8a3ba9061aa89aab3ffcdf4c7a90230.jpg

Hey Raiders!

Welcome to this weeks patch update! 

Community Fridays
Before we go into the patch update, just a note that we will be hosting a competition this coming week! Details will be released on Friday!

Community Moderators
Remember that you can also apply to be a community moderator! Details are on the Monday 27th Weekly announcement.

Below you can see the details for this weeks patch:

Feature:
Active Duty Bonus
- Each day that the player logs in to the online version of their camp, they receive a reward.
- If the player continues to log in on consecutive days, the reward increases, peaking after 5 consecutive days, at which point the cycle resets.
- If the player fails to log in for a day, the cycle also resets, and they must start a new streak of consecutive logins.

Crash:
- Fixed a crash, when interacting with the mission table. When the player did a raid on Hard or Very Hard and the top mission in the mission selection screen did not have these difficulties unlocked the game would crash, because the game saved the difficulty of the last played raid.
- Fixed a crash, when pressing enter on the mission unlock screen. When the player went to the missions screen after unlocking a new mission, the player would get a choice between 3 missions, upon pressing enter here without selecting any of the 3 missions the game would crash.

Animation:
- Fixed a minor visual bug, when holding the sten with the Tier 2 Decrease Spread upgrade.
- Fixed an issue, where the the positioning of the left hand was wrong when operating the turret and using the double-barreled shotgun.

Art:
- Fixed a minor visual bug, where gold bar would be clipping through the boat on Forest

Sound:
- Fixed an issue where the client was unable to hear the indication for the flamer. (heavey breathing)

Misc Bugs:
- Fixed an issue where the warcries were not displayed properly. All players would see that the other players would have Recon warcries although they were different classes.

Community Team

Daily Login Reward System

So, you guys spoke and we listened to the need for more rewards. Content is something that we are always working on, but in the meantime for those who are regular players you get a login reward that accumulates as you log into RAID. For now, its gold, but let’s see what we add in the future!

Bugs

Last Fridays stream was really fun, and it was one of the longer stream we did. It was a really positive sign, and we for sure want to showcase upcoming content to the community in its beta form. We will reach out to create a community mod dedicated Stream. More news on this soon!

notes.title: RAID: World War II - Weekly Newsletter 20/11/2017
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/7dc4177b25ade99c0cd3ea0662db49cccaeb1658.jpg

Hey Raiders!

Welcome to this week’s newsletter!
Another busy week for RAID: World War II as we enter Thanksgiving and beyond! So, we hope all the players states side enjoy their turkeys or anyone else who is celebrating.

Weekly Patch

As usual we will be updating the game this week. We have a number of bugs fixed, and a few bugs in specific where grenade kills not refilling the WarCry meter and the Scavenger proficiency not working when the ammo box has less than 10 ammo will be fixed.

Animation Variations

Last week we updated all the primary weapons to have unique animation based on the grips, and this week we will add those for the secondary weapons!

Grenades

We reviewed the forum comments about the grenades and their power, and this week we will change some of the grenade functions. The grenades base damage will be raised and the killzone will be increased, this should make them more viable for Hard and Very Hard modes. The damage the grenade does to the players have also been raised so use them wisely.

Competition

Thanks to everyone for taking part so far in this week’s competition! We have seen some wonderful creative entries. Remember that the point in this competition is to inspire creativity with the community and we certainly enjoy being closer to the community! The finalists will be announced Tuesday, where votes will begin for the top 3 winners ending on Thursday. For all those who haven’t taken part, why not give it a go!

Silo Level

To all those wondering, the Silo level is coming along nicely! And this week we will begin a private beta test with some Streamers and the top 3 winners of this week’s competition!

Live Stream

On Friday we will hold a live stream with PeaseMaker and of this week’s competition winners who want to join. We are excited to watch you play the Silo level and hold an open discussion about it where we can do an in-depth Q&A.

notes.title: RAID: World War II - Update 8
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/163ea61be8a3ba9061aa89aab3ffcdf4c7a90230.jpg

Hey Raiders!

Hope you all enjoy this weeks patch. We as always look forward to your feedback and seeing you enjoy the new content!

Here is the changelist of this weeks update 8 patch!

Weapons

Tokarev TT-33:
Unlocks at level 5 for all classes
 PREVIEW
 
Degtyaryov DP-28:
Unlocks at level 13 for the Demolitions class and at level 15 for the Assault class
 PREVIEW
 
XP tweaks

loot xp rewards increased: loot crates should now reward players with more XP across the board, with higher-tier crates now giving up to 50% more XP than before (on average)

Mission xp rewards tweaked: base XP rewards for finishing missions have been revised, with Odin's Fall, Gold Rush, The Amber Train, Wiretap, Trainwreck and Strongpoint now awarding 2500 XP (instead of 2000), while Bunker Busters and Extraction now award players with 1250 XP (instead of 1000)

Difficulty xp rewards tweaked: completing a mission on Hard difficulty now awards a 400% XP bonus (instead of 300%), while completing it on Very Hard awards a 900% bonus (instead of 800%)
 
Gold store

Added the functionality to the Gold Store which allows players to switch between Camp Upgrades
 
Bugs

Restarting the level while failing the mission, caused several issues (Church loading in level, god-mode)

Fixed an issue where a stringID for the controller appears when entering the kubelwagen with the spy inside it

Fixed a crash that would happen when selecting quit to main menu while being on an AA gun
 
Fixed an issue on Bunker Busters where the Greed chest was seen floating in mid air

Fixed an issue on Last Orders where a spotter was standing in mid air

Fixed an issue on Last Orders where in stealth the game would go loud if people dropped in while the others were in the foxholes

Fixed an issue on Wiretap where a greed item could not be interacted with
 
Animation

Fixed an issue on the grenades which did not have a visual indication when charging it

Fixed an issue where the marching mace's attack was shown as a knife attack animation in third player perspective

Update the animations so that all primary weapons have the correct grip in relation to the weapon upgrade the player has
 
Art

Fixed some issues with decals and Z-fighting on Amber Train, Bunker Busters and Trainwreck
 
Localisation
 
Fixed several cases where text was not displayed correctly

Fixed the dogtag notification screen to display the text properly

Added the name WG (winner of the grenade art competition) to the wooden boards in the camp

notes.content:

Gameplay 

Last Orders: Changed mission script and objectives in the level to support stealth and loud gameplay. 

Stealth: In stealth the player is able ambush the Convoy.

Added functionality in the weapons menu, to enable/disable weapon cosmetics. This way the player can decide if they want to show/hide weapon modifications while keeping the increased stats on the weapons.

Other fixes 

Fixed an issue that the Decrease Recoil weapon upgrade for the Springfield would not display a stat increase
Fixed an issue where players could enter the bunkers from the outside on Odin's Fall RAID by interating with the turrets from the outside
Fixed some locations where you could not interact with a crowbar
Fixed multiple clipping issues on Strongpoint
Fixed an issue on Gold Rush, where enemies could not reach the player
Fixed an issue with the values of proficiency: Strong Back

notes.content:

Hey Raiders!

Welcome to the weekly RAID: World War II weekly patch!
As always, we bring you our promised content with the game localised to Simplified Chinese, and we also have included a new Grenade! You voted for it, so we brought it. Have fun with the Concrete Grenade, and go make some things go boom!

Weekly Stream
Tomorrow we will be doing our weekly stream! Join us while we talk about a whole range of topics for RAID: World War II




This update to RAID: World War 2 includes the following changes and fixes:

NEW WEAPON

The Concrete Grenade has been added to the game!
The Concrete Grenade creates a more powerful blast than the standard M24 Stielhandgranate, but the low amount of metal in its construction means its fragmentation effect is reduced - as such, it deals more damage than the M24, but has a smaller area of effect
The Concrete Grenade becomes available to the Demolitions class at Level 6, to the Insurgent class at Level 7 and to the Assault and Recon classes at Level 8

LOCALIZATION

RAID: World War 2 can now be played with the Simplified Chinese character set

GAMEPLAY

The base XP reward has been increased for The Amber Train, Trainwreck, Odin’s Fall, Gold Rush, Wiretap and Strongpoint
The positions of dog tags on Wiretap, Odin’s Fall, The Amber Train, Strongpoint, Extraction, Hunters and Bunker Busters have been revised and updated
Positions of the intel files that unlock Outlaw RAIDs has been revised and updated on Trainwreck, Wiretap, Hunters, Tiger Trap and Extraction
Fixed positions of some lootable crates on Extraction
Improved enemy AI navigation in certain parts of the Wiretap map

OTHER FIXES

Fixed an issue that could cause the player to get stuck and be unable to move on Odin’s Fall
Fixed various clipping and other visual issues across many levels

notes.title: RAID: World War II - Update 5 ( Halloween! )
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/4f9e3cf71e566a60582cfe95edb10de72c79d285.jpg

Hey Raiders!

Welcome to our weekly patch! But more, welcome to the RAID: World War II Halloween Event!

Lasting until our next patch, which should see you enjoy past 31st October.

Challenge Cards
The Halloween Event is Based around Challenge Cards, and as an end of mission reward you will see the special card pack drop.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/3dde32c965905cb93bf03135ee4513a5523126d6.jpg

Rewards
We have already announced the Bloody Machete, and additionally we have a really cool outfit (top and bottom) that will drop as rewards.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/ba018377dd39a0c89185d13998758c7d5833282f.png


This update to RAID: World War 2 includes the following changes and fixes:

HALLOWEEN EVENT

The war gets a little spookier in RAID’s first seasonal event!
The Halloween Event will be active from 26 October to 1 November and adds several unique new features to the game...
Unique Challenge Cards! While the Halloween Event is active, every time you earn a card pack from completing RAIDs and Operations, there’s a high chance it will be a unique pack of Halloween Challenge Cards
The Pumpkin Pie Challenge Card gives all enemies pumpkin heads and greatly increases the damage they take from headshots, but players can only attack while in mid-air - jump for victory
The Season Of Resurrection Challenge Card changes the usual death mechanics - instead of going into bleedout, players who run out of health will become trapped in the world of spirits until a living teammate shoots a pumpkin, returning all downed players to life!
The Slasher Movie Challenge Card limits all players on the mission to using only melee weapons, but they gain increased melee damage and constant health regeneration
As well as the usual XP bonus, completing a RAID with the Slasher Movie Challenge Card active grants all players involved a unique melee weapon, the Bloody Machete!
Unique Character Customizations! While the Halloween Event is active, every time you earn a character customization from completing RAIDs and Operations, there’s a high chance it’ll be a unique Jack-o’-Lantern jacket or the matching trousers! 
Camp decorations! The RAID gang have decided to celebrate the season by decorating the Camp in suitably spooky style - including dragging the Church’s old organ out of storage!
Please note that the Halloween Challenge Cards and Character Customizations are unique to the event, and will only be available as mission rewards while the event is active - be sure to grab them while you can!

GAMEPLAY

The cost to retrain a character’s Proficiencies has been slightly reduced
Improved AI navigation on various parts of the Berlin map used in Operations

GRAPHICS

Fixed some clipping issues with Greed Caches
Fixed some clipping issues with the sandbags on Last Orders
All the lamps in the Camp should now have power cables running to them
Fixed an issue that could cause brooms to mysteriously disappear from view on The Amber Train
Fixed some issues with flickering textures on Odin’s Fall
Fixed some issues with lighting on Trainwreck

OTHER FIXES

Fixed an issue that could cause players to get stuck in scenery and be unable to move on Odin’s Fall
Fixed an issue that could cause a player’s game to lock up on the Blinding Heimdall stage of the Clear Skies Operation

notes.content:

Hey Raiders!

As Halloween draws nearer get ready for our Spooky Event coming soon!

Halloween Event
So! we already announce that it’s a Challenge Card event and tomorrow we showcase the next card out of the limited time pack of 3 cards that will drop just for the event! We will make sure that we lower the card drops for this new pack so you can enjoy it and the event! Tomorrow we also announce the first event reward!

Grenade
We are just finalising the Grenade and plan to release it after the Halloween event. We are looking forward to your feedback on the new grenade and what you might possibly want for new Grenades!

DP and TT33
It was a little while since our Weapon Poll and you must all be wondering what’s going on with these weapons. Well, we haven’t forgotten to get them ready for you, and will have them ready in the next few weeks!

As always, we fix bugs with each weekly patch. Please be sure to put all your bugs in the bugs section on the Steam Forums so we can track them and put them into our workload.

Friday Stream
