Here are a few things we did for this week’s patch.

Future Content / Thursday Announcement

We can’t say too much just yet, but we are working really hard to create some super exciting content for you all! Thursday this week we will announce a little part of it, but we want you to know you have some really cool things we think coming up!

Balance

We reviewed Bunkers that we felt still needed some attention. It needed more covers, places to funnel enemies especially in open areas. Where the player could get swamped by many enemies with nowhere to hide., especially at the rear of the level behind the bunker.

On top of that we worked on some AI navigation on some other levels.
We will continue doing passes on other levels as we review and get the community feedback.

German Version

The German version now has unmuted VO and all languages available. We are closely monitoring the laws surrounding Nazi iconography, and as soon as it allows us to we will put the German version in line with the global version.

Future Fixes / Updates

We want you to know that if your fix or issue isn’t yet dealt with, we review all posts and other channels. We are paying attention, and we are working on some of them behind the scenes. Weekly patches are just one way for us to get updates to you on a regular basis!
This update to RAID: World War 2 includes the following changes and fixes:

GAMEPLAY


Revised and improved the balance of Bunker Busters, including adding more cover and supplies, and removing some of the enemy machinegun nests on the initial approach to the bunker itself - please let us know what you think of the changes!
Fixed some broken reward spawns on Bunker Busters
Improved AI navigation on Gold Rush
Improved AI navigation on Strongpoint
Improved AI navigation on various parts of the Berlin map used Operations
Fixed an issue with enemy spawns on Last Orders
Fixed some issues that could allow enemies to shoot through walls on Strongpoint and Odin’s Fall
Fixed various issues with the enemy corpses that must be hidden in the early stages of Last Orders
Updated and improved the locations of Greed items on many maps
LOCALIZATION

Players in Germany should now have access to the fully localized version of the game in all all available languages (English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, and Russian)
The muting of certain words and phrases in the voice over of the German version of the game has been removed
UI/UX

Updated the way the game calculates the ‘Accuracy’ rating on the Weapons screen, and the ratings should now better reflect the relative accuracy of different weapons - note that the accuracy/spread stats of weapons have not changed, just the formula used to give them a 1-100 rating
GRAPHICS

Fixed various visual issues with the Thompson M1A1, C96 Mauser and Webley Mk VI, and added new animated parts to the Webley
Updated and improved the German Knuckleduster visuals
Fixed and improved several visual elements of the Camp and camp upgrades
Fixed some enemy animation issues at the start of Bunker Busters
Fixed an issue on Bunker Busters that could cause dead enemies to get stuck in walls
Fixed some visual issues on Strongpoint
Fixed some visual issues on Gold Rush
Fixed several graphical issues that could be caused by climbing on top of things at various points in The Amber Room
Fixed some visual issues in various parts of the Berlin map used in Operations
Fixed some visual issues when driving the Kübelwagen at certain FoV settings or when looking around at certain angles
Fixed some visual issues that could cause parts of the Kübelwagen to flicker

OTHER FIXES

Fixed an issue that could cause a crash when driving the Kübelwagen 
Fixed various issues that could cause the player to get stuck on some levels
Fixed an issue that could cause the player to become ‘invisible’ to enemies on Wiretap
Fixed some issues that could cause the player to fall ‘out of the world’ on Strongpoint and Last Orders
Fixed several collision issues on The Amber Room

Hey Raiders!

notes.title: RAID: World War II - Update 3
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/c61cc105ba792f776a19b50b7f3a5aa2f0d81541.jpg

Hey Raiders!
Just before we move onto the patch, remember that we have an art contest, and we would love for you all to vote! You can do so for your favourite Grenade inspired artwork which makes it into the game here. The winner will be announced Thursday:

 VOTE HERE!
 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/b8e082365c090cb29da481b6ad5e6ea1651bb979.jpg 

Our weekly patch has arrived!
As we wrote on Monday we have a larger patch update for today. The list would have been way too long for all the small details but here are the highlights:

Weapon
Double Barrel Shotgun is in! Now go blow off some Nazi heads and enjoy!
Remember that there will be more weapons down the line, so stick with us and let’s grow the weapons list.

Balance
We wanted to focus on the specials and the rate at which they spawn to round the balance some more. What we did was reduce the rate at which snipers constantly spawned and respawned. You should now see Snipers more spaced out across all difficulties.

We wanted to tweak Very Hard just a little with this update, so we changed the allowance of Commanders spawning to just one at a time. This should stop the double buff the enemy AI get.

Team AI also was made a little tougher, and their damage has been buffed.
We also took a look at a number of levels such as Extraction and Bunker Busters, to diversify the amount of enemies spawning from the same location at the same rate. You should see combat more directed from certain locations.

Level Art
We wanted to take a level and give it an art treatment to raise the quality and atmosphere. So, we chose Strongpoint. Have a play and let us know what you think! Perhaps you can help us decide on the next level to give an art treatment to!

Enough chit-chat, here are the patch notes:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/c61cc105ba792f776a19b50b7f3a5aa2f0d81541.jpg

This update to RAID: World War 2 includes the following changes and fixes:

NEW WEAPON

The Double-Barreled Shotgun, winner of the recent Weapon Poll, has been added to the game!
The Double-Barreled Shotgun becomes available to the Demolitions class at Level 10 and the Insurgent class at Level 13
The Double-Barreled Shotgun deals more damage and has a wider cone of fire than the M12, but its damage falls off more rapidly with range

GAMEPLAY

Increased the damage dealt by AI teammates on all Difficulty Levels
Revised the spawning of enemies across all Difficulty Levels on Hunters, Extraction, Bunker Busters, Last Orders, Tiger Trap and Rogues Gallery
Slightly reduced the damage dealt by enemy troops using the Kar98k on Hard Difficulty
Only one enemy Officer can be alive at the same time on Very Hard Difficulty
Tweaked several aspects of stealth gameplay, including enemy detection speed and reaction to dead bodies
Some of the shelves in the bunker on Bunker Busters have been replaced with crates
When a downed player is being revived by an AI teammate, other players should now see the downed player’s bleedout timer stop
Reduced the camera shake from melee hits and explosions
Made many minor fixes and improvements to multiple levels

GRAPHICS

The Stronghold level has been revised and updated - please let us know what you think of the new version!
Improved the ‘glow’ effect on ammo, medical supplies and grenades that players can pick up, making them easier to see
Improved the way that the names above character’s heads are displayed, which should make it easier to tell who is who
Updated the StG 44 model to improve the visuals when aiming with the scope upgrade equipped
Updated the Mosin Nagant model to improve the visuals when aiming with the scope equipped
Adjusted the positioning of the ‘Double Magazine’ upgrade for the Sten MkII
Improved the textures of the German Knuckleduster
Fixed an issue with the fitting of the wooden stock upgrade and receiver on the MP38
Fixed an issue that could cause the player’s arm to clip through the weapon when aiming the BAR Heavy Rifle
Fixed an issue with the player’s left hand when sprinting with the BAR Heavy Rifle
Fixed an issue with certain melee weapons that could cause the player’s right thumb to disappear when the weapon is fully charged
Fixed many visual issues and glitches throughout the game (far too many to  list them all)

SOUND

Fixed some incorrect voiceover in Operation Rhinegold
Made several fixes to various sounds throughout the game

UI/UX

It should now be possible to enter chat text with the keyboard when playing with a controller
‘Cancel Lockpick’ and ‘Jump’ now share a hotkey (default [SPACE]), which can be rebound in the Options menu
Fixed an issue that could cause chat messages to be repeated

OTHER FIXES

Fixed an issue that could cause Weapon Upgrade Challenges to get ‘stuck’, preventing the player from applying further upgrades to the weapon
Fixed an issue that could cause a crash just before a mission is failed by the player being killed
Fixed an issue that could cause a crash when returning to Camp
Fixed an issue that could cause players with heavy lag to crash when another player joined the same game
Fixed an issue that could cause a crash when the host of a multiplayer game goes into bleedout
Fixed an issue that could cause a crash when battering an enemy with a grenade
Fixed an issue that could crashes if the host of a multiplayer game left while other players were in certain menu screens
Fixed an issue that could cause the host to crash when other players enter a vehicle
Fixed an issue that could cause a crash when in stealth on Odin’s Fall
Fixed an issue that could cause desyncs during the ‘Take Out The Bombers’ objective when playing The Amber Room in multiplayer
Fixed an issue that could cause the objective on Last Orders to fail to update
Fixed an issue where loading a flak shell would not cause the mission objective to update on some levels
Fixed several issues that could occur when restarting levels
Fixed several issues with picking up certain Dog Tags and Greed items on several levels
Fixed several locations where the player could get stuck on several levels
Fixed an issue that could cause mission objective items such as gold crates to become impossible to pick up when dropped in certain locations
Fixed an issue that could cause Challenge and Booster cards to not be consumed when used
Fixed an issue with the ‘100 Nazi Scalps’ Achievement
Fixed many minor collision issues across multiple levels
Fixed several text errors and other typos throughout the game

notes.title: RAID: World War II - Weekly Newsletter 10/9/2017
notes.content:
Hey Raiders!

Welcome to the Monday weekly newsletter!

We have been working super hard reading through the bugs to fix issues, looking at the game to add some polish, race away to create some content, so we hope you like this week’s plan!

Level Polish
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/5dc0dc96ef63d5cc05d1ad9084cc353b11d0bf29.jpg

We took a step back and reviewed the art pass on some levels, and felt we could go a step further. For this week chose one level to improve upon, and this week’s level was Strong Point. We wanted to give it more atmosphere and certainly hope you like the results!

Perhaps you can let us know your thoughts on what next level we should give some more love to?

New Weapon

So, as you voted and we promised, this week you will get a new weapon! The Double-Barrelled Shotgun will be sure to make an impact when you pull the trigger and say BLAMO!

Balance

This week we have done a balance pass on the specials spawns, timings, and difficulty throughout the levels on difficulties to give it a general update. We also worked on the friendly AI to buff their damage a little more to help those solo, and less than 4 players.

But as always, we have more balance and AI polish to come!

Community Competition

notes.title: RAID: World War II - Update 2
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/173a6c9d28819e9a1972c8c11e7a5a62cd728aeb.jpg

Hello Raiders!

Another Wednesday, another patch!	
This week we have put some focus on the AI and some of the difficulty issues that we have seen around the forums, and other social channels. The AI should feel much better with less enemies trying to charge you non stop. The Hard difficulty has gotten some love as well, make sure you read the patch notes for the full info. Also, have a play and let us know how you think it's progressing!

As we mentioned we will be continuing the balancing so the plan is to continue this for next patch as well, so make sure to voice your feedback to us after you have tried it out! Next one is going to focus more on the teammate AI.

Weapon poll!
Tomorrow we reveal the weapon poll! If you haven't yet, then make sure you vote! You can do that here:

RAID: World War II Weapons Poll 

On Friday, we will have another developer stream, make sure you tune in to that as we might have some cool things to show, but also a surprise! :)

I plan to be live on stream with Tuffcooke, answering questions and playing the game. There is a thread for it right here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/414740/discussions/0/1519260397799878379/

Make sure you post your questions there if anything is on your mind!

PATCH NOTES:
This update to RAID: World War 2 includes the following changes and fixes:

GAMEPLAY

Enemies on all Difficulties should now behave more tactically, with fewer headlong charges straight at the player
The rate at which enemies spawn on Hard Difficulty has been reduced
The damage done by enemies armed with the Kar98k or shotgun on Hard Difficulty has been slightly reduced
The damage done by enemy Sniper shots on Hard Difficulty has been reduced, but they are now slightly more accurate
The Speed Loader Proficiency now correctly stacks with Challenge Card effects that alter reload speed

MISSIONS

The map for Hunters now features more terrain and other objects that can be used as cover
It is no longer possible to throw enemy bodies into the escape truck on Hunters
Adjusted the positions of some Greed items on Hunters
Fixed an issue on Hunters that could create invisible Greed items
Fixed some collision issues on Hunters
The amount of gold you must recover from the train on Trainwreck now scales according to the Difficulty Level, and the train will no longer have any ‘extra’ gold
Enemy spawn locations have been adjusted on Extraction, and enemies should now be better at finding and using cover throughout the level
Fixed an issue that could cause the spies to refuse to enter the escape plane on Extraction, stalling the mission and making it impossible to complete
Fixed an issue that could cause special enemies to spawn on Extraction while the player is in stealth
Fixed an issue that could cause the player to get stuck on Extraction
Fixed an issue that could cause crowbars to appear floating in midair on Extraction
Fixed some collision issues on Extraction

OTHER FIXES

Fixed an issue that could cause Greed progress to be lost when quitting the game from the Camp Menu
When continuing Operations in Offline Mode, the game would incorrectly display the option to change the Difficulty Level - this could cause crashes and has been removed
Fixed an issue that could cause crashes in multiplayer mode
Fixed an issue that could be caused when unplugging and plugging in a controller while in certain menus

notes.title: RAID: World War II - Weekly Newsletter
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/0df2f688d2fdd53a5ac297c1dc00ddc3a39cc3d4.jpg

Hey Raiders!
It’s been a week since launch and we are busy getting on with updates for you. We think its super important to keep regular conversation with you all, and update you on RAID: World War II since its now in live development.
We would like to start off with a few keys points of activity we will do throughout the week and each coming week! Here is an introduction rundown of what’s to be expected from us!

Monday Weekly Newsletter
We get so much information from you each week, that we decided it’s important that we update you with whats to come each week! Expect communication from us each Monday on the various social media channels, with a post here that sums up the week to come.

Patching
We keep an eye on, observe, investigate all the posts that you guys do here on the Steam Forums, but also on the other channels (Twitter, Facebook, emails etc). We take all this information and turn it into tasks for us as a development team. And we intend to update RAID: World War II once a week with bug fixes, polish, and even content.

Balancing
We have been busy playtesting RAID: World War II and working on improving the AI behaviour in the game. As we said we will continue working on this to give you guys the best possible experience. 

For this week, we have worked on balancing the AI so it feels less “hordy”. One of the things we did was to tone down the enemies that were running into you as a player and enhance the enemies to use their tactics so and the different enemy groups stand out more, where you will notice them using different tactics depending on the group. You should now see enemies taking cover more, flanking more and staying at their firing range.
As always have a play and let us know what you think!

Weapon Poll
On Thursday, we will give the final results of the weapon poll we did!
Thanks so much for voting and the turn out so far has been great! If you haven’t voted yet, please do! Here is the link to cast your vote:

RAID: World War II Weapons Poll 

The first weapon will be out soon!

Community Fridays
Last Friday was great! We had fun talking to you all, answering your questions, giving feedback and letting you know of what’s to come in the future!

So, we will have a weekly Twitch Steam from now on, the next one is Friday at 7pm (same time as usual). To tune in join, us at:
https://go.twitch.tv/liongamelion

So! Thanks for all the support, being awesome, and looking forward to showing you guys more content soon! <3

/Ilija

notes.title: RAID: World War II - Update 1
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/e08cd7d644a9b45515171c86505a0482411dac99.jpg

Raiders!

So we are live! It is nice that see that so many of you are enjoying the game. 
We have been hard at work with updates/patches and new content that we can reveal and show more of very soon!

Thanks for all the suggestions and feedback on the forums here on steam and on other channels ( discord / Facebook / email / twitter)



http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/c81af51c392f4b003610451d715bf9d4467ef39a.jpg

Tomorrow Friday, we will have a developer stream at  07.00 PM CEST (UTC +2) , where we talk about the patch, have a short QA, and maybe also have another little surprise for you all :) 

Next patch will focus on AI behavior and fixes.





This update to RAID: World War 2 includes the following changes and fixes:

GAMEPLAY

Team AI are now less likely to be interrupted while reviving players and other team AI characters
Team AI are now slightly tougher and more resistant to damage

UI/UX

It is now possible to switch between weapons by using the mouse scroll wheel
Chat is now available while a player is dead and waiting to respawn
In the Ready Up screen, the ‘Ready’ button is now always available, even when viewing another player’s details
The default tab on the Weapons screen is now ‘All’
The distances for Weapon Upgrade Challenges that require kills above a certain range are now consistently displayed in meters (previously some were listed in centimeters)

FIXES

Fixed an issue that could cause a crash at the end of missions
Fixed an issue that could cause crashes when moving the trucks in Extraction
Fixed an issue in the Tutorial where the game would not recognise that the player had thrown the guard’s body into the dumpster, resulting in them having to restart the mission
Fixed an issue that could cause player weapons to ‘vibrate’ or shake around at low FPS
Fixed several minor issues in the Tutorial
Fixed an issue that could cause an error string when activating the Special Edition of the game
Fixed several typos in text descriptions


/ Ilija

notes.title: RAID is live!
notes.content:
http://www.raidworldwar2.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/RAID_live.jpg

RAID is live!
 
Raiders!
 
Time has come, we are releasing RAID: World War II. I always find this time of the development cycle exciting!
 
Exciting… but also stressful, and scary and nerve-wracking. You are happy, you are stressed, you are emotional.
 
All this work, all the sleepless nights, all the long hours, not seeing our families, our kids, our loved ones. Because we believe in and are passionate about this game. We all do our absolute best to make it the best it can be. The cycle is full of ups and downs, lefts and rights.
 
In the end, what matters is that you guys enjoy it! And that is why we put so much emphasis on community communication, listening to what you guys want, and trying to work with you.
 
There were lots of comments when the BETA launched about what we could or could not do in 3 weeks. But believe me, with you the community and this development team we can do anything. I think we proved that with multiple patches, fixes, more content, more additions all from the feedback you gave. Simply put, we do this because we love it.
 
Also, you may communicate with me the most (or Arash and Renic), but know that there is a creative and passionate team behind us. I’m not making this game, the Lion game Lion team is and I’m just the messenger. So, I would like to officially express my gratitude for every single one of them here.
 
Our road to releasing RAID has been long, filled with obstacles, emergencies, sadness, happiness, stress, anger, exhaustion to name a few. But we stick together as a team, and that is what matters.
 
 So, we are now live! You can play RAID: World War II! We really hope you enjoy it. 
 
 
So, from the whole LGL team, a big thank you!

notes.title: RAID Content highlight - "Operation: Rhinegold"
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/6ce8a5f0801bec18e1e322fde8e70e2dc318cf85.jpg

Hello fellow Raiders!

Below all the screenshots you will find the change log from end of beta. Its things that the community has reported and wanted, we have listened and fixed and added a bunch of stuff! You will find the change log at the bottom of the announcement.

It's the sixth and final day of our map highlight! We have really enjoyed sharing this with you and we can’t wait to let you people play it and hear your opinions on it.

Without any further ado, this is "Operation Rhinegold"! 

Spanning several missions, the RAID Gang get an emergency message to save a resistance spy and have to act fast to save him. 
Their actions lead to the unravelling of an undercover plot by the Nazi war machine which the RAID Gang must now unwind. We hope you will enjoy it :)

So.. we are launching tomorrow and it with a mixture feelings that we are writing this, right now we are crunching hard.
We are tired but at the same time really happy and looking forward to tomorrow so much! 
As a game developer you give away a lot of your free time, you lock yourself in, work day and night and rarely get to see the sunlight but it’s ALL worth it once you get to show your game to the players.
That is the reward as a game developer.

Also tomorrow is the last day of the Pre-Order bonus so if you are interested in receiving the exclusive army crate with lots of goodies and the Pre-Order discount you have one day left :)

http://www.raidworldwar2.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/bjoern678.gif

http://www.raidworldwar2.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/aelg998.gif


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/b36a847aa0700a7e6ad76f0a9493d2165d9067ef.jpg

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/d2042935a396bb81ee16de1c26cc4420df7104b7.jpg

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/7ad7b967be0b0c222118c40b18a45a69a517cd30.jpg

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/f0cf20ac8470a534c72ddb416e6eb55a65744a62.jpg



CHANGES DONE AFTER BETA END

GAMEPLAY & BALANCE
Rebalanced many aspects of player weapons, weapon upgrades and Proficiencies to create a more skill based gameplay.
Balanced the War cries so they should feel equally powerful.
Recon warcry has been reworked. It now hits every shot as long as an enemy is “locked” making it more powerful and balanced with other war cries.
Sniper rifle rounds now penetrate enemies, potentially hitting additional enemies behind them to create a bigger incitament to use sniper rifles
Single bolt weapons now don't have “hipshot” weapon challenges, instead it has been changed to “Kill enemies on X distance” to promote class plays.
Reduced the targets for pistol weapon upgrade challenges, making them easier to complete
The M1 Carbine now has additional weapon upgrades to be able to keep up with the other weapons on higher levels.

Snipers are now more dangerous, especially at higher difficulty levels, making teamplay and different classes more valuable than before.
Enemy AI now makes better use of range and cover, this gives them more tactical improvements depending on the unit.

Separated Camera Acceleration Effects and Head Bobbing in Video Options
Improved textures on several player weapons
Added several new enemy animations
Fixed many visual glitches and errors throughout the entire game
Improved lighting and environmental effects in many levels


SOUND
Many fixes, tweaks and improvements to sound effects and VO throughout the entire game
Grenade “tinnitus” sound has been removed and tweaked to be more “friendly” to the ears


FIXES
Fixed several crashes
Squashed many, many bugs - literally hundreds of them

LEVELS
Multiple graphical tweaks and upgrades across all missions
All levels from the beta have had a optimization pass and should perform much better
Spawn intervals have been revisited across the board for a smoother gameplay experience
Collision passes have been done on all BETA levels to reduce the players from getting stuck
Enemies spread out and use covers in a more efficient way, making them less “zergy”



And off course a whole lot of other stuff, that are not on this list, that you will see when the game goes live!

/Ilija

Hey Raiders!

It’s time for another content reveal! 

Introducing Last Orders!

In Last Orders, the RAID Gang are assigned by Mrs White to send a personal message to the Führer himself! 
That message being, everything can be taken from you - nobody and nothing is unreachable for the RAID Gang.

A convoy of trucks is headed towards “Schloss Goldschadel.” Aboard of one of these trucks is 
Hitler's personal sommelier. The RAID Gang is going to ambush this convoy, kill the sommelier and grab as much delicacies and luxury items as they as they can, ultimately pissing Hitler off a lot!

Hey Raiders!

Here is our latest content reveal! This time we thought a lot about the theme and era and decided to take a classical World War II setting and give it a RAID twist.

Introducing Bunker Busters!

A long-running staple of the WWII genre, bunker stormings are something we definitely wanted in the game. In this mission, the RAID Gang have to dodge across turret fire in order to reach the heavily fortified bunkers.

Mrs White has found out that the infamous Night Witches all-female bombing squadron have been shot down and captured on their last bombing run! The RAID Gang have to bust their way in and get them out alive! Easier said than done and the death of even a single Night Witch will certainly be a blow to the war effort.

Hey Raiders!

Without further ado, here is our look at an all new content reveal for RAID: World War II!

We decided to keep the action pace for this showcase but add an air of mystery and suspense.

Introducing Strong Point!

Deep in the alps is Castle Schloss Blomberg. A mysterious place that isn’t easy to get to, where the Nazis secretly have been planning their campaigns across Europe.

Mrs White has been informed by her network that two very valuable assets have been captured… Generals from the eastern Russian flank. The RAID Gang can’t make their way through the rugged terrain with checkpoints all the way to the castle, so they have only one option… parachute in!

This level has the RAID gang finding their only option is to assault their way through the eerie castle, and with time running out before the Generals have had valuable information extracted from them, what hard decisions will the RAID Gang have to take!?

RAID HIGHLIGHT Day 2

RAID HIGHLIGHT Day 2

Hey Raiders!

Welcome to Day 2 of our week-long content highlight! This time, we have opted for some blood-pumping action waiting for you on September 26th in RAID: World War II.

Introducing Gold Rush!

Here the RAID Gang have one job and one job only, hit the Nazis hard where it hurts! 

As we all know gold is hoarded during times of war and Nazi gold is something to behold. So what better way than the RAID Gang go in hard and take down their most valuable Treasury.

I always have an adrenaline rush when playing this mission, and I think you and your RAID team will enjoy going in guns blazing while trying to find the best way into the Treasury. It isn’t going to be an easy ride, getting in, but an explosive “ride” getting away… (hope you get what I mean there :) ).

We wanted to make this one feel like an action movie with an exciting exit.

Mrs White wants to drain the Nazi party of as much Gold as possible, so she sends in the RAID Gang to Blast and steal their way in and out. The RAID Gang aren’t alone and Sabre Squadron, the elite bomber pilots are sent in to help! This is a large urban area with multiple ways through. How will the RAID Gang utilize Sabre Squadron to help out!? I guess you’re going to make that “call”!

notes.title: Beta End, and future content
notes.content:
Hello Raiders!

A BIG THANK YOU

So, the Beta is over, and you can have a little rest from all the Nazi Raiding, but don’t rest for too long, because soon we hope you’ll be back behind enemy lines doing what you do best! shooting, stealing, and exploding, and... you know all that stuff that makes Nazis sad, and Hitler Angry!

The beta was amazing for us, and we got a lot of technical issues sorted out, you guys have helped a lot, and all your feedback and all you bug reports are being looked into. Some of them were fixed during the Beta as you saw!

FEEDBACK

What happens now? Well… we are continuing our hard work towards release. We want to make sure that the release is as smooth as possible, and that you can enjoy the game to its full extent.

Just one thing before we start talking about the future and the full release.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=POVKaUwYXYY&feature=youtu.be&t=4
This is a really good video, highlighting a lot of the issues that the community in have been reporting. These types of videos are so great, we get good feedback on what you guys think, we get good feedback on why you think that, and we can move forward accordingly. There are several really good forum posts also as well that allows us to focus on community issues as we develop easier, because we want to include you, the players. After all, we are making this for you.

Thanks to Connor Shaw for the video, and thanks all of you on Reddit / Steam forums / Twitter / Facebook / Discord etc etc for the questions, suggestions and feedback.

BALANCING
When it comes to balancing, as some of you noted in patch 1.3, you experienced some issues. This was due to the first major overhaul of the balancing pass going into the Beta. We needed this feedback in a live environment in order to get some feedback. Don’t fret as this wasn’t the balance overhaul finished with. We took this feedback and are still working on this now!

We want to end up with something that we are proud of and that you like to play so our aim is to resolve some key issues:

Make less spongy AI, that is not difficult because they have lots of health, but rather because they are better at aiming, and faster at responding. This is something that has been balanced over the last few days since the beta and we think we are headed in a great direction.

Multiple AI tactics and behaviour so the AI doesn’t just stand, or only hoard. This was added during the BETA. Where enemies feel much better in the way they act during different situations. And now we have balanced out the distances so the AI doesn’t all group together and the tactics are starting to shine through.

We also want to make sure that the weapon upgrades give you something, you are working to earn them, so they need to grant you more power, we want you to feel the difference after you spend time upgrading your weapons.
Still quite a few bugs were fixed in the AI for that patch which you couldn’t directly see but it was all “under the hood”. 

So, our way forward is going to be much easier from now on. The aim now is to continue balancing the difficulties, and make sure that the game is fun over and over, so you have a randomised, repayable experience that has AI that feels interesting.

RELEASE GAME CONTENT
Moving forward! notes.title: Beta End, and future content
notes.content:
Hello Raiders!

A BIG THANK YOU

So, the Beta is over, and you can have a little rest from all the Nazi Raiding, but don’t rest for too long, because soon we hope you’ll be back behind enemy lines doing what you do best! shooting, stealing, and exploding, and... you know all that stuff that makes Nazis sad, and Hitler Angry!

The beta was amazing for us, and we got a lot of technical issues sorted out, you guys have helped a lot, and all your feedback and all you bug reports are being looked into. Some of them were fixed during the Beta as you saw!

FEEDBACK

What happens now? Well… we are continuing our hard work towards release. We want to make sure that the release is as smooth as possible, and that you can enjoy the game to its full extent.

Just one thing before we start talking about the future and the full release.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=POVKaUwYXYY&feature=youtu.be&t=4
This is a really good video, highlighting a lot of the issues that the community in have been reporting. These types of videos are so great, we get good feedback on what you guys think, we get good feedback on why you think that, and we can move forward accordingly. There are several really good forum posts also as well that allows us to focus on community issues as we develop easier, because we want to include you, the players. After all, we are making this for you.

Thanks to Connor Shaw for the video, and thanks all of you on Reddit / Steam forums / Twitter / Facebook / Discord etc etc for the questions, suggestions and feedback.

BALANCING
When it comes to balancing, as some of you noted in patch 1.3, you experienced some issues. This was due to the first major overhaul of the balancing pass going into the Beta. We needed this feedback in a live environment in order to get some feedback. Don’t fret as this wasn’t the balance overhaul finished with. We took this feedback and are still working on this now!

We want to end up with something that we are proud of and that you like to play so our aim is to resolve some key issues:

Make less spongy AI, that is not difficult because they have lots of health, but rather because they are better at aiming, and faster at responding. This is something that has been balanced over the last few days since the beta and we think we are headed in a great direction.

Multiple AI tactics and behaviour so the AI doesn’t just stand, or only hoard. This was added during the BETA. Where enemies feel much better in the way they act during different situations. And now we have balanced out the distances so the AI doesn’t all group together and the tactics are starting to shine through.

We also want to make sure that the weapon upgrades give you something, you are working to earn them, so they need to grant you more power, we want you to feel the difference after you spend time upgrading your weapons.
Still quite a few bugs were fixed in the AI for that patch which you couldn’t directly see but it was all “under the hood”. 

So, our way forward is going to be much easier from now on. The aim now is to continue balancing the difficulties, and make sure that the game is fun over and over, so you have a randomised, repayable experience that has AI that feels interesting.

notes.title: RAID: World War II - BETA - Patch 1.31
notes.content:
Hey Raiders!

So you guys have been really great! Helping us Beta test RAID: World War II. You have played, asked for changes, reported bugs, commented on the forums, and we would like to give a big thank you to you all! We certainly hope to see you behind enemy lines come September 26th!

We have listened to your feedback, made changes and improvements and will continue listening to your feedback and updating the game after we go LIVE!

RAID: World War II is a game as a service. We intend to keep it alive with all kinds of updates for things you guys want, and updates that continue the story of the RAID Gang!

Today's update is the last of the Beta and we have centered it around a rework of the game's balancing. Remember, that we will continue this even after the Beta is over.

LIVE STEAM:
To coincide with this weekend's final Beta, we will be online playing RAID this Sunday with you all! Keep an eye out as we join in on the community games, please join us on Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/liongamelion



This update to the RAID: World War 2 Beta includes the following changes and fixes:

BALANCE

Enemy stats, AI and spawning have been revised and rebalanced - please let us know what you think of the changes!
Enemies are now connected to different difficulties to create consistency.
Enemy's HP is adjusted to suit the new difficulty levels.
Numbers of enemies have been slightly raised on all raids.
Tweaked enemy aim, aim delay, and melee damage
Enemy AI has been redefined and are now utilizing tactics more.
Further refinements have been made to the revised recoil and accuracy systems for player weapons

GAMEPLAY

The Flammenwerfer trooper will no longer fly around in a flame tornado
Fixed an issue on Odin’s Fall that could cause stealth to be cancelled unfairly

GRAPHICS

Added new textures for all enemies
Improved several visual aspects of the Springfield M1903’s scope
Improved and fixed several issues with player weapon and weapon upgrade textures
Fixed some visual issues with the mounted machine guns found in several missions
Fixed several visual issues on The Amber Train
Fixed some visual issues on Trainwreck
Tweaked texture on enemy Stg44
Fixed some texture issues in the Tutorial

SOUND

Fixed an issue with sound effects when the player leaves a mounted machine gun
Fixed an issue with sound effects when being revived

FIXES

Fixed an issue that could prevent early beta characters from unlocking upgrades on recently added weapons
Fixed an issue that could cause a crash in the loot screen following a mission
Fixed an issue that could cause a crash in offline mode
Fixed an issue that could cause players in offline mode to appear in the server list
Fixed an issue that could lock the player out of the menus after failing to connect in multiplayer
Fixed an issue that could cause a mission’s dogtag count to be displayed incorrectly for clients in multiplayer
Fixed an issue on Odin’s Fall that allowed the player to pick the locks of open doors
Fixed an issue on Odin’s Fall that could cause waypoint indicators to be displayed incorrectly
Fixed an issue on Odin’s Fall that could allow enemies to shoot players through a wall
Fixed some collision issues on Odin’s Fall
Fixed an issue on The Amber Train that could cause players to get stuck between a door and a shelf
Fixed some missing collisions on The Amber Train
Fixed an issue on Tiger Trap that could cause players to get stuck inside destroyed tanks
Fixed some collision issues with the trees on Hunters

notes.title: RAID: World War II - BETA - Patch 1.21
notes.content:
Raiders!
 
We hope you have been enjoying the latest content from our Beta 1.20 release!

We have another update! We said we will be focussing on balancing and here is an update for us to work on some issues we felt needed.

As always we really want to hear your feedback! So please play and tell us how it feels.
 
Recoil

Changed recoil and spread system to allow greater adjustment of weapons to differentiate them from each other
All Beta weapons have had their recoil and spread values changed to work with the new system
All weapons are now generally more accurate, however they have much greater recoil
Ironsighting weapons will make them much much more accurate
 
Enemy spawns

Reduced the rest time between assault waves on all difficulties up to Very Hard
Increased the movement speed and dodge probability on light and heavy enemies
Increased the general amount of enemies which will appear
Reduced the optimal ranges for enemies so that they approach the player more often
Fallschirmjäger units will only start showing up on Normal difficulty in small amounts
Elite enemies will only start showing up on Very Hard
Hard difficulty will ramp up the units that spawn throughout the raid more aggressively

notes.title: RAID: World War II - Closed BETA - Patch 1.2
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/d2ef7e2e0e22bf524817822e4efd67e605787f35.jpg

Raiders! Welcome to our German friends!

The time has come for a new RAID for you all to try out! More info below. Together with the new RAID we are activating some new weapons, raising the level cap to 15. And also, if that was not enough, we will add a new feature: Challenge cards!

These will drop in the end of the missions ( raise the chance by finding more dog tags ) Challenge cards can be suggested by all the players in the ready screen, and the Host can then before the mission start choose what card to play.

The next update will focus on fixes, performance and balancing. Maybe more content to, who knows :)

But, enough talking from us, here are the patch notes for 1.2, Enjoy!

This update to the RAID: World War 2 Beta includes the following changes and fixes:

NEW BETA FEATURES

Added support for additional aspect ratios and resolutions ( other than 16:9 )
A new RAID has been unlocked for the beta - assault a German depot and destroy their new tanks before they can be used against Allied forces in Tiger Trap!
Beta characters can now advance to Level 15, allowing them to unlock additional Proficiencies, Warcry Upgrades, and Tier II Weapon Upgrades

Weapons

Player proficiency upgrades will be reset and will need to be reapplied
Many new player weapons have been unlocked for the beta
All classes gain a new base primary weapon, available at Level 1
All classes will now unlock additional weapons as they advance in level
Existing beta characters should gain all the weapons appropriate for their current level, so be sure to check the Weapons Bench in camp

Challenge & Booster Cards

A limited selection of Challenge and Booster Cards can now be earned as mission rewards
Challenge Cards impose special rules or restrictions on a mission, in return for an increased XP reward if the mission is completed successfully
Booster Cards give a bonus to all players for the duration of a mission, but do not increase the XP earned
Challenge and Booster Cards can be assigned to a mission in the Ready screen (in multiplayer games, each player can suggest one of their cards to use, and the host can choose between them or start the mission without a card)
Challenge and Booster Cards are consumed when used, whether the mission is completed or failed
As with other mission rewards, higher value reward crates have a higher chance to contain Card Packs - collect dogtags in missions to earn higher value reward crates
Your collection of cards can be viewed at the Card table in camp, or via the ‘Cards’ option in the camp menu

BALANCE & GAMEPLAY

Warcries can now be activated while using a mounted machine gun
Activating the Berserk Warcry will reduce the overheating of a mounted machine gun according to the level of the Warcry
Prevented AI teammates from getting too far away from the player


GRAPHICS

Made several improvements to the visuals on the Trainwreck level
Made several improvements to the visuals on the Tutorial level
When in bleedout, calling to a teammate will now display a hand animation
Fixed a visual glitch that could occur when Rivet fired the C96 Mauser while wearing certain character customizations
Fixed some visual glitches with Wolfgang’s trousers
Fixed an issue that could cause character customizations to be displayed incorrectly when switching tabs in the Customize Character screen
Fixed an issue that could cause visual glitches when viewing character stats
Fixed an issue that could cause certain the Springfield M1903 Rifle to not use the correct textures
Updated the textures of the Springfield M1903 Rifle in first-person view
Updated the textures and materials for Recruit, Regular and Veteran versions of basic German Soldier enemies (‘grunts’)
Fixed some visual glitches with the Regular and Veteran versions of Gebirgsjager enemies
Updated and improved the muzzle flash of the mounted machine gun
Fixed an issue that could cause distance buildings to flicker

SOUND

Added additional voiceover lines to warn of incoming enemy assaults
Removed the pitch change on the ‘ears ringing’ sound effect following explosions at close range

OTHER FIXES

Fixed several issues that could cause the game to crash in various situations
Fixed an issue that could cause multiplayer games to desync
Fixed an issue that could cause enemies to spawn from a blank wall on Odin’s Fall
Fixed an issue the could cause enemies to walk through a wall on Odin’s Fall
Fixed an issue that could cause enemies to get stuck in a corridor on Odin’s Fall
Fixed an issue that could cause a waypoint indicator to not update after an objective is completed on Odin’s Fall
Made various fixes to the patrols and mounted machine guns on Odin’s Fall
Fixed an issue that could be caused by interacting with a mounted machine gun while falling
Fixed an issue that could cause inappropriate events to occur while the player is in stealth
Removed camera shake from ‘near misses’, which should make counter-sniping and other long-range shooting slightly easier
Fixed an issue that could cause duplicate mission rewards to be awarded
Improved the ‘awareness of danger’ of various enemies - they may now attempt to dodge or sidestep when being aimed at
Fixed an issue that could cause a player joining an ongoing mission to not see all enemy animations
Fixed an issue that could cause the player to start a mission without ammo
Fixed an issue that could cause the player to be unable to use their secondary weapon when in bleedout
Fixed an issue that could cause lockpicking interaction to not display correctly
Fixed an issue the could cause AI teammates in bleedout to ‘teleport’ to the player

Challenge and Booster Cards can be assigned to a mission in the Ready screen (in multiplayer games, each player can suggest one of their cards to use, and the host can choose between them or start the mission without a card)
Challenge and Booster Cards are consumed when used, whether the mission is completed or failed
As with other mission rewards, higher value reward crates have a higher chance to contain Card Packs - collect dogtags in missions to earn higher value reward crates
Your collection of cards can be viewed at the Card table in camp, or via the ‘Cards’ option in the camp menu

BALANCE & GAMEPLAY

Warcries can now be activated while using a mounted machine gun
Activating the Berserk Warcry will reduce the overheating of a mounted machine gun according to the level of the Warcry
Prevented AI teammates from getting too far away from the player


GRAPHICS

Made several improvements to the visuals on the Trainwreck level
Made several improvements to the visuals on the Tutorial level
When in bleedout, calling to a teammate will now display a hand animation
Fixed a visual glitch that could occur when Rivet fired the C96 Mauser while wearing certain character customizations
Fixed some visual glitches with Wolfgang’s trousers
Fixed an issue that could cause character customizations to be displayed incorrectly when switching tabs in the Customize Character screen
Fixed an issue that could cause visual glitches when viewing character stats
Fixed an issue that could cause certain the Springfield M1903 Rifle to not use the correct textures
Updated the textures of the Springfield M1903 Rifle in first-person view
Updated the textures and materials for Recruit, Regular and Veteran versions of basic German Soldier enemies (‘grunts’)
Fixed some visual glitches with the Regular and Veteran versions of Gebirgsjager enemies
Updated and improved the muzzle flash of the mounted machine gun
Fixed an issue that could cause distance buildings to flicker

SOUND

Added additional voiceover lines to warn of incoming enemy assaults
Removed the pitch change on the ‘ears ringing’ sound effect following explosions at close range

OTHER FIXES

Fixed several issues that could cause the game to crash in various situations
Fixed an issue that could cause multiplayer games to desync
Fixed an issue that could cause enemies to spawn from a blank wall on Odin’s Fall
Fixed an issue the could cause enemies to walk through a wall on Odin’s Fall
Fixed an issue that could cause enemies to get stuck in a corridor on Odin’s Fall
Fixed an issue that could cause a waypoint indicator to not update after an objective is completed on Odin’s Fall
Made various fixes to the patrols and mounted machine guns on Odin’s Fall
Fixed an issue that could be caused by interacting with a mounted machine gun while falling
Fixed an issue that could cause inappropriate events to occur while the player is in stealth
Removed camera shake from ‘near misses’, which should make counter-sniping and other long-range shooting slightly easier
Fixed an issue that could cause duplicate mission rewards to be awarded
Improved the ‘awareness of danger’ of various enemies - they may now attempt to dodge or sidestep when being aimed at
Fixed an issue that could cause a player joining an ongoing mission to not see all enemy animations
Fixed an issue that could cause the player to start a mission without ammo
Fixed an issue that could cause the player to be unable to use their secondary weapon when in bleedout
Fixed an issue that could cause lockpicking interaction to not display correctly
Fixed an issue the could cause AI teammates in bleedout to ‘teleport’ to the player

notes.title: RAID: World War II - Closed BETA - Patch 1.12
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/bcf519dc23d9871dbee4d5ad0ffa2a5f57573e85.jpg

Raiders! New update for you all! We have been working on some issues that a lot of you have reported during the BETA. This patch will focus on Video Settings, and adds to the game some things that lot of players have been asking for. The nVidia card fix should help a lot of users to get better performance out of RAID, and it is not longer necessary to set the default graphics card manually. We are looking into adding support for more resolutions for the next patch as well. 

We hope you enjoy these fixes while we get back to work and preparing the next update for you all. Next update will be a content update, this is what we are working on now. 

Again, we would like to thank all of you who are reporting bugs, and giving suggestions, we are listening and looking into every single feedback thread! 

This update to the RAID: World War 2 Beta includes the following changes and fixes:

Graphics & Video Options

On laptops with both integrated and dedicated GPUs, the game will now default to using the dedicated GPU, which should result in improved performance
Added a ‘Depth of Field’ toggle to Advanced Video Options
‘Frame Rate Limit’ in Advanced Video Options now supports 144 and Unlimited frame rates
‘Use Camera Acceleration Effects’ in Video Options now toggles player ‘headbob’ when moving
‘FOV Adjustment’ in Advanced Video Options now offers a wider range of adjustment and displays the actual field of view value

notes.title: RAID: World War II - Closed BETA - Patch 1.11
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/75ab8d003cef7a87f1a1ddd6ac44c179bc98fd3f.jpg

Hey guys, just a quick update for you all, we are working on the next content update, meanwhile we will release this patch in between where some of the reported issues from the community have been fixed. We are also looking into the technical issues that some of you are experiencing ( DOF / Resolutions other than 16:9 / low FPS problems / Unlimited FPS cap) more info on that soon!

Until then, enjoy these fixes, and keep that feedback rolling!

This update to the RAID: World War 2 Beta includes the following changes and fixes:

BALANCE

Increased the height at which a fall results in automatic death and slightly reduced damage for non-lethal falls
Revised enemy weapon and accuracy stats to emphasise the differences in range between different weapons and make enemy shooting behaviour more consistent - in general, enemies are now slightly less accurate at longer ranges
Recruit Grunt, Standard Grunt, Standard Gebirgsjager and Standard Fallschirmjager enemies should now dodge slightly more often
Increased the movement speed of Standard Fallschirmjager enemies 
Enemies will no longer try to hide behind the Flammenwerfer

FIXES

Fixed an issue on Hunters that could cause players to get stuck under a mounted machinegun
Fixed an issue on Trainwreck where players could not interact with crates of gold after they had been thrown off the bridge
Fixed an issue on Trainwreck that could cause players to get stuck behind a railing
Fixed a visual issue that could cause the lower sections of the bridge on Trainwreck to flicker
Fixed an issue on Odin’s Fall that was preventing enemies in the bunkers from raising the alarm after spotting a player in stealth
Fixed an issue on Odin’s Fall that allowed enemies to shoot through certain walls
Fixed an issue on Odin’s Fall that allowed enemies to spawn too close to the player
Fixed a visual issue with the steps in front of the Flakturm on Odin’s Fall 
Fixed a visual issue with the BC41 Knuckle Knife
Fixed a visual issue with the bullets of the C96 Mauser pistol
Fixed an audio issue with Mrs. White character creation lines still playing even when master volume was set to 0%
Fixed some audio issues with banter between Kurgan and Rivet

notes.title: RAID: World War II - Closed BETA - Patch 1.1
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30493300/ae7509551feffc78eba61d02927a1117a15daaa2.jpg

Raiders!

A Message From Ilija, Creative Director
Hello everyone, my name is Ilija and I am the Creative Director for RAID: World War II. First of all, let me tell you on behalf of the whole Lion game Lion team: Thank you! Thank you for the feedback, for the laughs for the good times. We really appreciate all the feedback we are getting and are working on it as much and fast as we possibly can. The progress we have is thanks to your feedback, this is precisely why we have this BETA.

There have been some technical difficulties and some things have not been working as smooth as they should, but we are on it. We are working days, nights, weekends. But its all worth it, because of you.

We read every thread, post, Reddit post, Facebook message, tweet, email, discord chat to ensure that we collect the feedback you guys are giving us. It really is appreciated, so again thank you!

The BETA will keep growing, with more maps and more guns for you guys to try out, as well as bug fixes and other updates. The BETA is quite long and we hope you will feel the difference from start of the BETA towards the end of BETA.

Be sure to check our streams for more info when we go live on www.twitch.tv/liongamelion and keep the feedback coming. 

Now we are going back to work, to make the game better, for you, our players. This update to the RAID: World War 2 Beta includes the following changes and fixes:


BETA Patch 1.1

New BETA Features
●    A new RAID has been added to the beta - blow up a bridge and rob a Nazi gold train in the Trainwreck raid!
●    Beta characters can now advance to Level 10

Character Customization
●    A limited selection of Character Customizations can now be earned as mission rewards
●    Character Customizations change the appearance of a character’s upper body clothing or trousers
●    Unlocked Character Customizations can be selected by interacting with the Characters Table in camp or selecting ‘Characters’ from the camp menu

Melee Weapons
●    An alternate melee weapon can now be earned as a mission reward
●    Unlocked melee weapons can be selected by interacting with the Weapon Bench in camp or selecting ‘Weapons’ from the camp menu

Balance
●    Damage dealt by player weapons has been increased
●    The spread of the M12 Shotgun has been reduced and is now more consistent
●    Improved the hit detection for headshots
●    Increased the damage bonus from the Tier I Damage Upgrade

Fixes
●    Fixed a crash that could occur at the end of a mission
●    Fixed crashes that could occur when accessing menu while returning to camp
●    Fixed some geometry issues that could result players getting stuck on the Odin’s Fall map
●    Fixed an issue that could cause Odin’s Fall to show multiple exit markers at the same time
●    Fixed a geometry issue that could result in players falling through the ground on the Hunters map
●    Improved the interaction with the locked wooden crates on the Hunters map
●    Fixed a potential exploit on the Hunters map
●    Fixed an issue that could cause Flamer special enemies to spawn while the player is still in stealth
●    Fixed an issue that could cause the Com Wheel to spam team chat
●    Fixed the visual appearance of certain enemy soldier spawns
●    Fixed an issue that could cause Mrs. White’s voiceover to ignore volume settings in Options

See you on the stream today at 02:00PM! www.twitch.tv/liongamelion

Ilija Petrusic
Creative Director
Lion game Lion
